title: Non Hermitian Tight Binding Bands in Graphene from Tan Bo Model: Strain Effects and Bernal Bilayer Extensions
summary: Within the tight binding framework of graphenes π electron nearest neighbors, the Tan Bo model parametrizes transition energies t(dr) based on bond lengths and angles via the Mobius transformation combined with exponential decay. Comparisons between isotropic , geometrically anisotropic , and Slater Koster scales reveal that B = 0 is equivalent to the SK scheme, with L(B) reaching its optimum at Bopt = 0. The Hermitian assembly maintains the Dirac cone at the K point.The Tan Bo geometry dependent transition model and non Hermitian TB assembly scheme developed in this study provide a reproducible single particle benchmark and parameterization reference for future non Hermitian chemical calculations incorporating electron correlation effects in graphene systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在石墨烯紧束缚框架下，利用Tan Bo模型通过Möbius变换和指数衰减参数化跃迁能量t(dr)，发现最优参数Bopt=0等价于Slater-Koster方案，并建立了非厄米紧束缚组装方案，为未来包含电子关联效应的非厄米化学计算提供了可重复的单粒子基准。
AI.motivation: 在石墨烯π电子近邻紧束缚框架中，需要一种几何依赖的跃迁参数化模型，以更准确地描述键长和键角对跃迁能量的影响，并为非厄米化学计算提供基准。
AI.method: 采用Tan Bo模型，通过Möbius变换结合指数衰减来参数化跃迁能量t(dr)；比较了各向同性、几何各向异性和Slater-Koster标度；通过Hermitian组装保持K点狄拉克锥，并开发了非厄米TB组装方案。
AI.result: B=0等价于SK方案，且L(B)在Bopt=0处达到最优；Hermitian组装成功保持了K点的Dirac锥结构。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的Tan Bo几何依赖跃迁模型和非厄米TB组装方案，为未来石墨烯系统中包含电子关联效应的非厄米化学计算提供了可重复的单粒子基准和参数化参考。

title: Raman spectroscopy of the van der Waals altermagnet Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$
comment: Main text 7 pages. Supplementary text 9 pages
summary: We investigate the influence of Co intercalation and altermagnetic order on the lattice dynamics of the layered compound Co$_{1/4}$NbSe$_2$. Polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy, supported by density-functional theory, enables identification of six Raman-active phonons. Co intercalation drives a substantial reconstruction of the vibrational spectrum through zone folding of NbSe$_2$ phonons, producing hybridized modes with mixed zone-center and zone-boundary character. Despite this, Co atoms do not participate in any Raman-active modes by symmetry, which is in marked contrast to related 1/3 compounds where intercalant modes do contribute to the Raman spectrum. Temperature-dependent Raman measurements across the altermagnetic transition show no discontinuities, which is consistent with short-range spin correlations in the quasi-one-dimensional Co chains. However, we find evidence for spin-phonon coupling in A$_{1g}$ symmetry modes owing to their out-of-plane Se displacements. Our work demonstrates the substantial impact of intercalation on the vibrational properties of transition metal dichalcogenides and the presence of spin-phonon interactions in a newly discovered altermagnetic material.

AI.tldr: 本文通过拉曼光谱和DFT计算，研究了Co插层和交变磁序对Co₁/₄NbSe₂晶格动力学的影响，发现Co插层通过能带折叠重构振动谱，且Co原子不参与拉曼活性模式，但在A₁g对称模中观察到自旋-声子耦合。
AI.motivation: 探究Co插层和交变磁序对层状化合物Co₁/₄NbSe₂晶格动力学的影响，理解插层对过渡金属硫族化物振动性质的作用以及新发现的交变磁材料中的自旋-声子相互作用。
AI.method: 采用偏振分辨拉曼光谱实验，并结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，识别六个拉曼活性声子；通过变温拉曼测量研究交变磁转变过程中的声子行为。
AI.result: Co插层通过NbSe₂声子的能带折叠驱动振动谱重构，产生杂化模；Co原子因对称性不参与任何拉曼活性模（与1/3化合物不同）；交变磁转变温度附近未发现声子不连续性，但A₁g对称模存在自旋-声子耦合证据。
AI.conclusion: 插层对过渡金属硫族化物的振动性质有显著影响，并在新发现的交变磁材料中存在自旋-声子相互作用。

title: Domain-Growth Kinetics and Scaling Laws Governing Pulse-Driven Accumulative Polarization Switching in HZO
summary: Accumulative polarization switching driven by sequential sub-coercive electric-field pulses offers a promising route toward low-power ferroelectric memories and neuromorphic devices. However, the kinetic regimes governing this nonequilibrium process remain poorly understood. Here, we employ a phase-field model based on the time-dependent Landau-Ginzburg formalism to investigate pulse-driven accumulative switching in ferroelectric HZO. By systematically varying the initial domain configuration, pulse amplitude, pulse-on time, and pulse-off time, we establish a quantitative link between microscopic domain-wall dynamics and macroscopic polarization accumulation. We show that the effective switched-domain radius follows distinct scaling regimes characterized by the local kinetic exponent. Initially, a local exponent greater than 1 indicates superlinear domain growth driven by enhanced irreversible domain-wall propagation under successive pulses. As switching progresses, a local exponent close to unity marks steady self-similar growth, whereas a local exponent less than 1 signifies decelerating dynamics caused by geometric confinement, depletion of switchable polarization, and relaxation-induced back switching. The transition between these regimes is governed by the competition between field-driven excitation during the pulse-on interval and spontaneous relaxation during the pulse-off interval. The initial domain geometry further influences this transition. Increasing the pulse amplitude or pulse-on duration extends the superlinear regime, whereas longer pulse-off times promote relaxation and suppress accumulation. These findings establish a unified scaling framework for pulse-driven accumulative switching, providing quantitative insight into nonequilibrium ferroelectric domain evolution and design guidelines for HZO-based memory and neuromorphic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过相场模型研究了HZO铁电材料中由次共场脉冲驱动的累积极化翻转动力学，建立了微观畴壁运动与宏观极化累积之间的定量联系，揭示了三种不同的标度动力学区间（超线性、稳态自相似、减速），并阐明了脉冲参数和初始畴结构对动力学转变的影响。
AI.motivation: 累积极化翻转为实现低功耗铁电存储器和神经形态器件提供了有前景的途径，但其非平衡过程的动力学机制尚不清楚，缺乏定量理解。
AI.method: 采用基于时间依赖Landau-Ginzburg理论的相场模型，系统变化初始畴构型、脉冲幅值、脉冲开启时间和脉冲关闭时间，定量分析畴壁动力学与极化累积的关系。
AI.result: 发现了三种标度动力学区间：局部动力学指数>1（超线性畴生长）、≈1（稳态自相似生长）、<1（减速动力学）。超线性区间由不可逆畴壁传播驱动，减速区间由几何限制、可翻转极化耗尽和弛豫反向翻转导致。
AI.conclusion: 建立了脉冲驱动累积翻转的统一标度框架，为HZO基存储和神经形态器件的设计提供了定量指导。

title: Electric Field Induced Multi-Space Topological Phase Transitions in Janus Monolayer MnBi2Se2Te2
summary: Manipulating coexisting multi-space topological states within a single material is a critical frontier for low-power spintronic applications, for which perpendicular electric-field gating offers a highly precise tuning mechanism. Using first-principles calculations and atomistic spin simulations, it is demonstrated that Janus monolayer MnBi2Se2Te2 can exhibit simultaneous momentum-space and real-space topological phase transitions under an external electric field. Specifically, the electric field drives momentum-space transitions across a topologically trivial state (C = 0), a low-Chern-number quantum anomalous Hall state (C = -1), and a high-Chern-number state (C = 2). Concurrently, by actively tuning the competition between the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and magnetic anisotropy, the electric field induces real-space magnetic transitions from a uniform ferromagnetic state to an isolated skyrmion state, and ultimately to a skyrmion-spiral domain coexistence phase. Electric-field-induced variations in both the QAHE and magnetic textures may give rise to multiple topological phase transitions, involving distinct topological regimes: a purely k-space topology, RK-joint skyrmions, and pure real-space skyrmions. These findings establish a powerful material platform and efficient route for the synergistic control of coexisting topological orders, making it highly promising for next generation multi-functional spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和原子自旋模拟，证明Janus单层MnBi2Se2Te2可以在电场调控下同时实现动量空间（拓扑绝缘体/量子反常霍尔态）和实空间（斯格明子/螺旋畴）的多重拓扑相变，为多功能自旋电子器件提供了材料平台。
AI.motivation: 在单一材料中同时操控多种拓扑态（动量空间和实空间）是实现低功耗自旋电子学应用的关键前沿问题，电场调控提供了一种高精度的调控机制。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）和原子自旋模拟（atomistic spin simulations），研究Janus单层MnBi2Se2Te2在外电场作用下的拓扑性质变化。
AI.result: 电场可驱动动量空间从拓扑平庸态（C=0）到低陈数量子反常霍尔态（C=-1）再到高陈数态（C=2）的转变；同时通过调控Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与磁各向异性的竞争，驱动实空间从铁磁态到孤立斯格明子态再到斯格明子-螺旋畴共存相的转变。
AI.conclusion: 该材料体系为协同调控共存的多种拓扑序提供了有效途径，有望用于下一代多功能自旋电子器件。

title: Magnon-Mediated Superconductivity in a 2D Itinerant Ferromagnet with Weak Easy-plane Magnetic Anisotropy
summary: Motivated by recent observations of superconductivity in a quarter-metal state of spin- and valley- polarized graphene multilayers, we investigate pairing within a ferromagnetic phase of a single-valley model of itinerant two-dimensional (2D) electrons with Hubbard-type interaction and no artificial high-energy cutoff. In 2D, the Stoner transition is first-order into a fully-polarized state wherein the only gapless collective excitations are transverse magnons. We find that in a spin-SU(2) symmetric model, this magnon-mediated pairing interaction between equal-spin fermions vanishes at $T=0$. We show that a small easy-plane magnetic anisotropy $Ω_0 \ll E_F$, where $E_F$ is the Fermi energy, breaks the SU(2) symmetry and generates an attractive interaction for equal-spin $p-$wave pairing. We explicitly derive the corresponding coupling constant $λ_p$ as the scaling function of both the relative strength of the easy-plane anisotropy, $Ω_0/E_F$, and the proximity to the ferromagnetic transition. While $λ_p$ is parametrically small in $Ω_0/E_F$ deep inside the ferromagnetic phase, it becomes enhanced near the ferromagnetic transition, reaching order unity regardless of how small $Ω_0/E_F$ is. This mechanism yields a sizable $T_c$, peaked near the onset of ferromagnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在自旋和谷极化的石墨烯多层结构中发现的超导性，探讨了二维巡游电子铁磁相中的配对机制。研究表明，在SU(2)对称模型中，磁振子介导的配对相互作用在T=0时消失；而引入易面磁各向异性后，会产生等自旋p波配对吸引相互作用，且耦合常数在铁磁相变附近可达量级1，从而产生显著的超导转变温度。
AI.motivation: 受近期在自旋和谷极化石墨烯多层结构中观察到四分之一金属态超导性的启发，作者希望理解这种铁磁态中的超导配对机制及其微观起源。
AI.method: 采用单谷二维巡游电子Hubbard模型，无人工高能截断。通过分析SU(2)对称模型及引入易面磁各向异性，推导等自旋p波配对的耦合常数作为易面各向异性强度和接近铁磁相变程度的标度函数。
AI.result: 1) SU(2)对称模型中磁振子介导的等自旋配对在T=0时消失；2) 易面磁各向异性（Ω₀ ≪ E_F）可产生等自旋p波配对吸引；3) 耦合常数λ_p在铁磁相内部是Ω₀/E_F的参量小量，但在铁磁相变附近可增强至量级1；4) 超导转变温度Tc在铁磁序起始附近达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 该机制解释了为何在铁磁相变附近能产生显著的超导转变温度，为理解石墨烯多层结构中的超导性提供了理论依据，并提出易面各向异性是产生等自旋配对的关键因素。

title: Mass-Conserving Physics-Informed Neural Networks For The One-Dimensional Advection-Diffusion Equation
summary: The advection-diffusion equation is a fundamental model of transport phenomena in which mass conservation is an essential physical constraint. While classical schemes such as Crank-Nicolson preserve this property by construction, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) enforce only the local residual of the governing PDE and are therefore not guaranteed to conserve global quantities such as mass over long integration horizons. In this work, we examine the extent of this limitation for the periodic one-dimensional advection-diffusion equation and evaluate a Mass-Penalty PINN that augments the standard PINN loss with a soft mass-conservation constraint. We compare the performance of Vanilla PINN, Mass-Penalty PINN, and the Crank-Nicolson scheme across a range of Peclet numbers spanning diffusion-dominated to advection-dominated regimes, and over two simulation horizons representing short-term and long-term dynamics. The results show that, for short-term simulations, the Mass-Penalty PINN does not always provide a consistent improvement in accuracy. However, for long-term simulations, the Mass-Penalty PINN reduces the relative L2 error and mass conservation error by factors of approximately 9-67 and 15-215, respectively, compared with the Vanilla PINN, across the tested Peclet numbers. Further analysis reveals that the accuracy degradation observed in Vanilla PINN is predominantly caused by the accumulation of mass drift over time. These results demonstrate that incorporating a soft mass-conservation constraint substantially improves the long-term reliability of PINN for conservative transport problems, particularly in mitigating mass drift over extended simulation horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文针对周期性一维对流扩散方程，研究了标准PINN在长时间积分中因缺乏全局质量守恒约束而导致的质量漂移问题，并提出质量惩罚PINN（Mass-Penalty PINN）方法。实验表明，在长时间模拟中，质量惩罚PINN相比标准PINN可将相对L2误差降低约9-67倍，质量守恒误差降低约15-215倍，显著提升了长期模拟的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统数值格式（如Crank-Nicolson）天然保证质量守恒，而PINN仅强制PDE局部残差，无法保证全局质量守恒。本文旨在量化这一局限性的程度，并探索通过软约束改进PINN长期可靠性的可行性。
AI.method: 在标准PINN损失函数基础上，增加一个软质量守恒约束项（Mass-Penalty），形成Mass-Penalty PINN。在周期性一维对流扩散方程上，对比Vanilla PINN、Mass-Penalty PINN和Crank-Nicolson格式在不同Péclet数（扩散主导到对流主导）和不同模拟时长下的性能。
AI.result: 短时间模拟中，质量惩罚PINN未始终优于标准PINN；但在长时间模拟中，质量惩罚PINN的相对L2误差降低约9-67倍，质量守恒误差降低约15-215倍。标准PINN的精度退化主要由质量漂移随时间累积导致。
AI.conclusion: 引入软质量守恒约束能显著提升PINN在保守输运问题上的长期可靠性，有效缓解长时间模拟中的质量漂移问题。

title: Anomalous suppression of quantum chaos between two integrable limits
summary: Level statistics in non-integrable quantum many-body systems with time reversal symmetry are expected to follow the Gaussian Orthogonal Ensemble (GOE), a hallmark of quantum chaos. However, we show that the interacting Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model exhibits a clear suppression of the mean level-spacing ratio $\langle r\rangle$ from the GOE value $\approx 0.535$, persisting deep in the nonintegrable regime. This challenges the conventional association between non-integrability and fully chaotic spectral statistics. Using exact diagonalization supported by semi-analytical arguments, we trace this anomaly to incomplete hybridization of many-body band states inherited from the noninteracting band structure. The resulting restructuring of the spectrum weakens level repulsion without restoring integrability. We show the robustness of this mechanism in extensions of the model which break chiral and inversion symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在相互作用的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型中，能级间距比⟨r⟩显著偏离量子混沌预期的GOE值0.535，且该偏离在非可积区域持续存在，挑战了非可积性与完全混沌谱统计的传统关联。通过精确对角化和半解析论证，作者将此异常归因于非相互作用能带结构继承的多体带态不完全杂化，该机制在破坏手性和反演对称性的模型扩展中依然稳健。
AI.motivation: 挑战非可积量子多体系统必然表现为完全混沌谱统计（GOE）的传统观念，揭示存在非可积但能级统计偏离GOE的反例。
AI.method: 利用精确对角化结合半解析论证，分析相互作用SSH模型的能级间距比⟨r⟩，并检验破缺手性和反演对称性扩展模型中的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现⟨r⟩显著低于GOE值0.535且持续存在；证明异常源于非相互作用带结构继承的多体带态不完全杂化；该效应在破缺对称性后依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 非可积性不一定导致完全的混沌谱统计；能带结构的遗传效应可以在不恢复可积性的情况下削弱能级排斥，为理解量子混沌与多体系统谱统计的关系提供新视角。

title: Magnetotransport of tomographic electrons in a Corbino disk
summary: In clean electron gases at low-to-moderate temperatures, odd-parity modes of the Fermi surface are anomalously long-lived due to Pauli blocking, giving rise to ``tomographic transport'' that is not captured by a hydrodynamic model. Here we show that tomographic flow in a Corbino disk induces an extended boundary layer near electrodes with superballistic transport and enhanced slip velocity, which leads to a parametric enhancement of the quadratic magnetoresistance coefficient. The enhancement depends explicitly on the electrode curvature, allowing its strength to be controlled by the device geometry. The magnetoresistance coefficient reveals three distinct regimes as a function of magnetic field: a tomographic regime at weak fields; a hydrodynamic regime at intermediate fields, reached when the cyclotron radius becomes comparable to a large odd-mode mean free path; and a conventional Ohmic regime at large fields, reached when the cyclotron radius becomes comparable to the short even-mode mean free path. The tomographic regime is characterized by an anomalous dependence of the magnetoresistance on temperature and density, which may account for recent experimentally observed anomalous scaling of the electron viscosity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Corbino盘中电子气体的层析输运，发现其产生超弹道边界层并增强二次磁阻系数，磁阻随磁场变化呈现层析、流体和欧姆三个不同区域。
AI.motivation: 低至中温下清洁电子气中费米面的奇宇称模因泡利阻塞而异常长寿命，产生层析输运现象，而传统流体动力学模型无法捕捉这一效应。
AI.method: 理论分析Corbino磁盘中的层析流，研究电极附近的扩展边界层、超弹道输运和滑移速度增强，并分析磁阻系数随磁场、温度和密度的变化。
AI.result: 发现(1)层析流导致超弹道输运和滑移速度增强，二次磁阻系数参数增强；(2)磁阻系数随磁场呈现三个区域：弱场层析区、中强场流体区、强场欧姆区；(3)层析区磁阻对温度和密度依赖异常，可解释实验中电子粘度的反常标度。
AI.conclusion: 层析输运在Corbino盘中产生独特的磁阻行为，电极曲率可调控增强强度，三个磁阻区域为实验提供了清晰可区分的特征。

title: EOM-CC Excited-State Gradients and Nonadiabatic Couplings on a Consumer GPU from a Contraction-DAG with Laplace-Transform J/K Kernels
summary: We present a unified, memory-bounded GPU realization of equation-of-motion coupled-cluster (EOM-CC) excited-state gradients and interstate nonadiabatic couplings (NACMEs) on a single 8\,GB consumer GPU. Both are built from one contraction directed acyclic graph: the EOM-CC relaxation is the reverse-mode transpose of the forward density build rather than a per-state re-derivation, and an atomic-orbital-direct Laplace-transform $J/K$ kernel, made non-symmetric ($J^x(A,B)\neq J^x(B,A)$) by the transition densities, resolves every energy denominator with no four-index molecular-orbital tensor; a two-sided Davidson returns both eigenvectors from one device-resident, spin-pure solve. The pipeline is \emph{validated end to end at small scale}: gradients and NACMEs match finite differences across four spin multiplicities and full configuration interaction to $<\!10^{-12}$ for two electrons, and the excited-state gradient matches the independent \textsc{Psi4} code to $\le\!4.6\times10^{-7}~E_h/a_0$ from \ce{H2O} to aromatic benzene. The kernels and the ground-state solve reach chromophores ($\le\!730$ AO) in 8\,GB, and a frozen-natural-virtual compression lets the eigensolver \emph{execute} a complete excited-state gradient and $Q$--$B$ NACME of the chlorophyll-core chromophore \ce{Mg}-porphine (def2-SVP, $439$ AO) on the card. We present that run as a \emph{capability demonstration} -- executed and translationally invariant to machine zero, but anchored only piece-wise and bounded by a direct convergence study at ${\sim}10^{-2}~E_h/a_0$ -- not a converged spectroscopic result. The validated small-scale capability and the memory-bounded implementation are the contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在单块8GB消费级GPU上实现的、统一且内存受限的运动方程耦合簇（EOM-CC）激发态梯度和非绝热耦合（NACME）计算方法。通过反向模式转置、拉普拉斯变换核以及双面Davidson求解器，实现了小规模端到端验证，并在色素分子上展示了能力。
AI.motivation: 现有EOM-CC激发态梯度和NACME计算计算开销大、内存需求高，通常需要多GPU或大规模集群，难以在单块消费级GPU上运行。作者希望提出一种统一、内存受限的GPU实现，降低硬件门槛。
AI.method: 1) 将EOM-CC弛豫构建为正向密度构建的反向模式转置，而非逐态重新推导；2) 使用原子轨道直接拉普拉斯变换J/K核，通过非对称过渡密度处理所有能量分母，避免四指标分子轨道张量；3) 双面Davidson方法在单设备上同时返回两个特征向量；4) 使用冻结自然虚拟压缩降低特征求解器内存需求。
AI.result: 小规模验证：梯度和NACME与有限差分在全组态相互作用下偏差<10⁻¹²（两电子），与Psi4代码对比偏差≤4.6×10⁻⁷ E_h/a₀（从H₂O到苯）。在8GB GPU上可处理最多730个原子轨道的色素分子，对Mg-porphine（439 AO）成功执行完整梯度计算和NACME计算，平移不变性达到机器零。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献在于验证的小规模能力和内存受限的实现，而非提供收敛的光谱结果。该方法降低了EOM-CC激发态计算对硬件资源的要求。

title: Three-point density correlations in a weakly interacting 2D Fermi liquid
summary: We study the three-point equal-time correlations of the density in a weakly interacting spin 1/2 Fermi gas and present two new results. First, we compute the three-point correlation for the total density $ρ= ρ_\uparrow + ρ_\downarrow$ exactly as a function of momentum to first order in a dimensionless interaction parameter ${\cal I}$. This generalizes a previous result that related the three-point function to the Landau Fermi liquid parameters $F_0^s$ and $F_0^a$ and applied in a certain long-wavelength collinear limit. Second, we compute the leading order ${\cal O}({\cal I}^3)$ interaction correction to the same-spin three-point correlation function in the long-wavelength collinear limit. These results are directly relevant to current experiments on atomic Fermi gases using quantum gas microscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了弱相互作用自旋1/2费米气体中密度的三点等时关联函数，给出了两个新结果：一是总密度三点关联函数作为动量函数的精确一阶微扰计算结果，二是同自旋三点关联函数在长波共线极限下的领头阶相互作用修正。
AI.motivation: 推广先前仅适用于长波共线极限的结果（关联Landau费米液体参数F⁰_s和F⁰_a），获得更一般的动量依赖的三点关联函数表达式，并计算更高阶的相互作用修正，以解释当前量子气体显微镜实验。
AI.method: 采用弱相互作用微扰理论，以无量纲相互作用参数I展开，分别计算总密度三点关联函数到一阶（作为动量函数精确求解），以及同自旋三点关联函数在长波共线极限下到O(I³)的领头阶修正。
AI.result: 1) 总密度三点关联函数的一阶微扰结果推广到任意动量；2) 同自旋三点关联函数获得O(I³)的领头阶相互作用修正。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果对当前利用量子气体显微镜进行的原子费米气体实验具有直接参考价值。

title: Ultrahigh-Entropy Compositionally Complex Ceramics: Fluorite-Pyrochlore Phase Stability and Order-Disorder Transitions
summary: Three groups of 32 ultrahigh-entropy compositionally complex ceramics (CCCs) containing 16-19 components were synthesized and characterized. The first group of 15 CCCs forms single ultrahigh-entropy fluorite or pyrochlore phases in 12 compositions, while two compositions exhibit fluorite-fluorite dual phases, observed for the first time. Compared with ternary A2B2O7 pyrochlore, these ultrahigh-entropy CCCs are more prone to ordering (pyrochlore formation), surprisingly even more at higher size disorder (more lattice distortion), with suppressed dual-phase formation relative to five-component high-entropy ceramics. Two new 19-component series, denoted as "19CCC-P|Fy" and "19CCC-P|Fz", form single ultrahigh-entropy fluorite or pyrochlore phases. The 19CCC-P|Fy series, maintaining a 2:2 ratio of 3+ and 4+ cations, exhibits a pyrochlore-to-fluorite order-disorder transition (ODT) at y ~ 0.84, consistent with the linear projection of the pyrochlore superstructure peak intensity as an order parameter. In contrast, the 19CCC-P|Fz series with non-2:2 ratios of 3+ and 4+ cations show an abrupt ODT at z ~ 0.41-0.44, despite a projected transition at z ~ 0.64 from the order parameter.

AI.tldr: 本研究合成了三组含16-19种组分的超高熵成分复杂陶瓷（CCCs），发现其更易形成有序烧绿石相而非无序萤石相，并揭示了两种19组分系列中不同的有序-无序转变行为。
AI.motivation: 探索超高熵（>5组分）成分复杂陶瓷的相形成规律，特别是理解组分数量增加对有序/无序相形成以及相稳定性的影响，填补超高熵陶瓷领域的研究空白。
AI.method: 合成三组共32种含16-19组分的超高熵CCC样品（包括两个19组分系列：19CCC-P|Fy和19CCC-P|Fz），通过X射线衍射等表征手段分析物相，以烧绿石超结构峰强度作为序参量研究有序-无序转变（ODT）。
AI.result: 1) 第一组15个成分中12个形成单相超高熵萤石或烧绿石，首次观察到萤石-萤石双相；2) 相比三元A2B2O7，超高熵CCC更易形成有序烧绿石，且在高尺寸无序（更多晶格畸变）下更倾向有序；3) 19CCC-P|Fy系列（保持3+/4+阳离子2:2比例）在y~0.84处发生ODT，与序参量线性投影一致；4) 19CCC-P|Fz系列（非2:2比例）在z~0.41-0.44处发生突变ODT，但序参量投影预计在z~0.64。
AI.conclusion: 超高熵显著影响陶瓷的相选择与有序-无序转变行为，组分间的阳离子比例（尤其是3+/4+比例）对ODT路径和临界点起关键作用，为设计新型超高熵陶瓷提供了重要指导。

title: Chiral-Structured Superconductors TrX4 (Tr = Rh, Ir; X = Ge, Si): A Platform for Mixed-Parity Pairing and Topological States
comment: Main Text 28 pages with 5 figures and 1 table; SI 14 pages with 5 figures and 7 tables
summary: Chiral-structured superconductors, with simultaneous broken mirror and inversion symmetries, promote unconventional superconductivity through parity-mixing mechanisms. Yet a few bulk chiral-structured superconductors are known, partly due to the difficulty in directly determining their atomic-scale chirality. Here we report three chiral-structured superconductors, , RhGe4, IrGe4, and IrSi4, synthesized under high pressure, with Tc values of about 1.6 K, 1.1 K, and 2.5 K, respectively.Using atomic resolution Cs-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) combined with X-ray diffraction characterizations, we directly confirm their chiral structure (space group P3121). This real space imaging approach overcomes ambiguities in traditional diffraction based methods. These materials exhibit type-II superconductivity, and the enhancement of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) leads to the emergence of mixed parity pairing. Calculations also reveal symmetry protected Weyl points near the Fermi level, which is robust against the SOC. Our work not only expands the family of chiral-structured superconductors but also demonstrates the indispensable role of STEM in directly determining chiral crystal structures. These materials thus offer a clean platform to explore the interplay among structural chirality, SOC, mixed parity superconductivity, and topological quantum phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了三种高压合成的手性结构超导体RhGe4、IrGe4和IrSi4，其超导转变温度分别为约1.6 K、1.1 K和2.5 K。通过原子分辨率的STEM结合XRD直接确认了其手性结构（空间群P3121），这些材料表现出第二类超导性，自旋轨道耦合增强导致混合宇称配对的出现，且计算揭示费米面附近存在受对称性保护的Weyl点。
AI.motivation: 手性结构超导体因同时打破镜面对称和反演对称而通过宇称混合机制促进非常规超导，但已知的块体手性结构超导体很少，部分原因在于难以直接确定其原子尺度的手性。因此，寻找新的手性结构超导体并发展直接确定其手性结构的方法具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用高压合成方法制备三种化合物；利用原子分辨率Cs校正扫描透射电子显微镜(STEM)结合X射线衍射进行晶体结构表征；通过实验测量确定超导性质；利用理论计算研究电子结构和拓扑性质。
AI.result: 成功合成了三种手性结构超导体RhGe4、IrGe4和IrSi4，Tc分别为约1.6 K、1.1 K和2.5 K；直接确认了其手性结构（空间群P3121）；证明了这些材料为第二类超导体；发现SOC增强导致混合宇称配对的出现；计算显示费米面附近存在受对称性保护的Weyl点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅扩展了手性结构超导体的家族，还展示了STEM在直接确定手性晶体结构中不可替代的作用。这些材料为探索结构手性、SOC、混合宇称超导性和拓扑量子现象之间的相互作用提供了清洁平台。

title: Gradient-Based Inverse Design of Free-Energy Landscapes with Diffusion Models
summary: Free-energy surfaces govern the populations of metastable states and the barriers that control transitions between them, making their direct optimization a central challenge in molecular and materials design. In this work, we introduce Gradient-Based Free Energy Surface Optimization (GB-FESO), an inverse design framework that uses a trained conditional diffusion model as a differentiable surrogate for the ensemble distribution. After training, the diffusion model is frozen, and the conditioning variables defining the system are optimized so that the generated ensemble reproduces a prescribed target free-energy surface. The optimization is carried out by backpropagating a distribution-level loss, based on kernel density estimates of the Kullback-Leibler divergence, through a deterministic diffusion sampling trajectory. We first validate GB-FESO on one-dimensional Gaussian ensembles, demonstrating that both continuous and relaxed discrete conditioning variables can be optimized to recover target distributions, including those outside the training domain. We then apply the method to a four-particle Lennard-Jones toy peptide exhibiting multiple metastable conformational states. In this more physically motivated setting, GB-FESO successfully optimizes the interaction parameters to reproduce target free-energy landscapes in the majority of test cases, with optimization performed either in the full internal-coordinate space or in a reduced collective-variable representation. These results establish GB-FESO as a promising first step toward an ensemble-level inverse design framework for molecular systems with prescribed thermodynamic and kinetic behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GB-FESO（基于梯度的自由能曲面优化）逆设计框架，利用条件扩散模型作为可微分的系综代理，通过反向传播分布级损失来优化系统的条件变量，使其生成的目标自由能曲面与预定义目标一致。在1D高斯系综和四粒子Lennard-Jones体系中验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 自由能曲面决定了亚稳态的群体分布及其间的能垒高度，直接优化自由能曲面是分子与材料设计的核心挑战。现有方法难以高效地进行系综级别的逆向设计。
AI.method: 训练条件扩散模型作为系综分布的可微分代理，冻结模型后，通过确定性扩散采样轨迹反向传播基于核密度估计的KL散度分布级损失，优化系统的条件变量（连续或离散），使生成的系综匹配目标自由能曲面。
AI.result: 1D高斯系综中，连续和松弛离散条件变量均能成功恢复目标分布（包括训练域外分布）；四粒子Lennard-Jones玩具肽中，在多数测试案例中成功优化了相互作用参数，可在全内坐标空间或降维的集体变量表示下进行优化。
AI.conclusion: GB-FESO是实现具有预设热力学和动力学行为的分子体系系综级逆设计的有前景的第一步。

title: Complete local expansion of the availability function in random sequential adsorption of aligned squares at low density: Termination at fourth order
summary: We consider random sequential adsorption (RSA) of aligned squares and derive the low-coverage expansion of the availability function alpha(q), the fraction of positions accessible to an additional square, up to fourth order in the coverage q. At low coverage, the reduction of available space can be understood in terms of geometric overlap between exclusion regions created by previously deposited squares. A single square blocks a finite area; pairs of squares may have overlapping exclusion zones, reducing the total blocked area; similarly, three and four squares can share a common overlap region, leading to higher-order corrections. These contributions can be systematically accounted for through an inclusion-exclusion expansion based on the geometry of overlapping exclusion regions, with alternating signs dictated by inclusion-exclusion. The expansion terminates exactly at fourth order, since no more than four deposited squares can simultaneously overlap the exclusion region of a trial insertion. The coefficients are obtained by explicit enumeration of all such geometrically admissible configurations and are further confirmed by numerical simulations on a discrete lattice, showing agreement within statistical uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对齐正方形在随机顺序吸附（RSA）中的可用性函数α(q)，推导了覆盖率q的展开式至四阶，并通过包含-排除原理和几何重叠分析得到精确系数，数值模拟验证了一致性。
AI.motivation: 理解低覆盖率下随机顺序吸附中可用空间减少的机制，特别是通过几何重叠和包含-排除原理系统性地解释高阶修正。
AI.method: 采用包含-排除展开方法，基于排除区域几何重叠，枚举所有几何上允许的构型，推导可用性函数α(q)的低覆盖率展开至四阶。
AI.result: 展开式精确终止于四阶，因为最多四个沉积正方形可同时重叠一个试探插入的排除区域；系数通过几何枚举得到，数值模拟验证了结果。
AI.conclusion: 对齐正方形RSA的可用性函数α(q)的低覆盖率展开可精确到四阶，由几何重叠机制完全决定，数值模拟支持该理论结果。

title: Effect of pressure on the magnetic properties of (Co$_{0.5}$Fe$_{0.5}$)$_5$GeTe$_2$
summary: Cobalt-doped Fe$_5$GeTe$_2$ possesses a rich magnetic phase diagram as a function of Co concentration. The nature of magnetic order in (Co$_{0.5}$Fe$_{0.5}$)$_5$GeTe$_2$ is especially interesting, as it has been shown to exhibit ferromagnetic order, A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM) order, or potentially both at the same time. Here we present magnetoresistance measurements on antiferromagnetic (Co$_{0.5}$Fe$_{0.5}$)$_5$GeTe$_2$ at a series of pressures and extract the anisotropy and interlayer exchange fields using the two-sublattice model. We show a 50 % increase of the interlayer exchange at 2 GPa, highlighting the sensitivity of magnetic properties to interlayer distance. In addition, we find that the sharp hysteretic transitions observed within the AFM state can be qualitatively described by a linear chain model, which suggests an even-odd effect as a function of layer number instead of a coexisting ferromagnetic phase.

AI.tldr: 本文通过磁电阻测量和双子晶格模型，研究了(Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂在压力下的磁性质，发现层间交换随压力增加50%，并提出AFM态中的磁滞转变由线性链模型的奇偶层数效应解释，而非铁磁共存相。
AI.motivation: Co掺杂Fe₅GeTe₂具有丰富的磁相图，特别是(Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂究竟呈现铁磁序、A型反铁磁序还是两者共存尚不明确，亟需澄清其磁有序本质。
AI.method: 对反铁磁(Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂施加不同压力进行磁电阻测量，利用双子晶格模型提取各向异性和层间交换场，并采用线性链模型定性描述AFM态中的尖锐磁滞转变。
AI.result: 在2 GPa压力下层间交换场增加50%，表明磁性质对层间距高度敏感；AFM态中的尖锐磁滞转变可由线性链模型定性解释，体现层数的奇偶效应。
AI.conclusion: AFM态中观察到的磁滞转变来自层数相关的奇偶效应，而非铁磁相共存；层间交换对压力的敏感性为调控这类材料的磁性质提供了途径。

title: Direct Analytical Evaluation of Electron-Impact Excitation Cross Sections via Multiconfigurational Binary Encounter Approach: Applications to Benzene and Naphthalene
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material available as an ancillary file; submitted to The Journal of Chemical Physics
summary: We present a multiconfigurational binary-encounter (MC-BE) framework for direct analytical evaluation of electron-impact electronic-excitation cross sections for dipole-allowed transitions from ab initio excited-state data. The method combines the threshold-modified Mott-Massey (TMMM) approximation with binary-encounter (BE/BE$f$) scaling. The effective binding energy in the BE/BE$f$ prefactor is obtained from amplitude-weighted occupied-orbital contributions computed by linear-response time-dependent density functional theory (LR-TDDFT), without system-specific fitting parameters. For benzene, MC-BE/TMMM cross sections for the dominant $1{}^{1}\!E_{\mathrm{1u}}$ ($π\!\to\!π^{\ast}$) band agree well with experiment at incident energies $T=10$-$20$ eV and improve on the Schwinger multichannel/truncated configuration-interaction singles results of Falkowski et al. [J. Chem. Phys. 159, 194301 (2023)] for this band and energy range. For naphthalene, the calculated total excitation cross section reproduces the onset and principal maximum of the gas-phase apparent fluorescence cross section, used as an emission-based proxy under dipole-dominated conditions, without empirical energy shifts or intensity scaling. Analytic peak-position and peak-height expressions, parameterized by $r=\langle B\rangle/ΔE$, show that typical valence excitations peak at incident energies $T\simeq 1.5$-$1.6ΔE$ with substantial BE attenuation, providing a diagnostic for relating measured cross-section profiles to excitation energies. Although demonstrated with LR-TDDFT, the framework is transferable to other excited-state theories that provide compatible amplitudes and well-defined orbital energies. These results support MC-BE/TMMM as a practical, inexpensive route for modeling electron-impact excitation of polyatomic molecules with finite oscillator strength.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多组态二元碰撞（MC-BE）框架，结合阈值修正的Mott-Massey（TMMM）近似，从第一性原理激发态数据直接解析计算偶极允许跃迁的电子碰撞激发截面。在苯和萘分子上验证了该方法，结果与实验吻合良好，无需经验参数调整。
AI.motivation: 现有的电子碰撞激发截面计算方法（如Schwinger多通道方法）计算成本高，且常依赖经验拟合参数。作者希望开发一种计算廉价、无需系统特定拟合参数、且能从第一性原理直接计算电子碰撞激发截面的普适性方法。
AI.method: 将阈值修正的Mott-Massey（TMMM）近似与二元碰撞（BE/BEf）标度相结合。有效结合能通过线性响应含时密度泛函理论（LR-TDDFT）计算的振幅加权占据轨道贡献获得，无需系统特定拟合参数。同时推导了峰值位置和峰高的解析表达式，由参数r=⟨B⟩/ΔE表征。
AI.result: 苯分子1¹E₁u (π→π*)带在10-20 eV入射能量范围内的MC-BE/TMMM截面与实验吻合良好，优于Schwinger多通道方法的结果。萘分子的总激发截面无需经验能量移动或强度缩放即可再现气相表观荧光截面的起始点和主峰。典型价电子激发在T≃1.5-1.6ΔE处达到峰值，且伴随显著的BE衰减。
AI.conclusion: MC-BE/TMMM框架是一种实用、低成本的多原子分子电子碰撞激发截面建模方法，适用于具有有限振荡强度的跃迁。该框架不限于LR-TDDFT，可迁移至其他提供兼容振幅和明确轨道能量的激发态理论。

title: Local moment magnon spectrum in conduction electron tunnelling
summary: The surface tunnelling spectrum of a dual system consisting of localised moments with antiferromagnetic order coupled to conduction electrons by on-site exchange interaction is investigated. In the static approximation of the local moment order it is known that magnetic band reconstruction leads to an anomalous tunnelling spectrum at the magnetic ordering vector of local moments although the latter cannot contribute directly. In this work we consider dynamic effects by including the scattering of conduction electrons from the local moment magnon excitations. They lead to self energies and renormalisation of conduction states which in turn appreciably modify the tunnelling spectrum beyond the influence of static order, interpreted as the appearance of magnon sidebands.

AI.tldr: 研究了具有反铁磁序的局域磁矩与传导电子耦合系统中的表面隧穿谱，发现动态效应（磁子激发）会导致静态近似以外的隧穿谱修正，表现为磁子边带的出现。
AI.motivation: 在静态近似下，磁能带重构会导致异常的隧穿谱，但局域磁矩的动态激发（磁子）对隧穿谱的影响尚未被充分研究，因此本文旨在探究动态效应如何进一步修正隧穿谱。
AI.method: 在静态近似基础上，进一步考虑了传导电子与局域磁矩磁子激发的散射，通过自能和传导能态的重整化来分析动态效应对隧穿谱的影响。
AI.result: 动态效应显著改变了隧穿谱，超出了静态有序的影响，具体表现为磁子边带（magnon sidebands）的出现。
AI.conclusion: 局域磁矩的磁子激发通过电子-磁子散射导致传导电子态的重整化，从而在隧穿谱中产生新的特征（磁子边带），这为理解强关联电子系统中的隧穿现象提供了更完整的理论框架。

title: From Closed-Loop Optimization to Open Decision Making: Coupled Digital Twins for Predictive and Autonomous Microscopy
summary: Automated experimentation is moving from closed-loop optimization toward open decision-making, where human or AI planners must forecast the consequences of candidate actions before executing them. Such forecasts require a model of both sides of the experiment: how the sample is likely to respond and what the instrument is likely to detect. We therefore introduce a coupled digital-twin framework that separates these roles and then links them. In this framework, the sample twin encodes material state inferred from prior knowledge and measurements till the moment. The instrument twin captures signal formation, feedback dynamics, and operating constraints based on prior knowledge. When coupled, the two twins estimate expected outcomes, uncertainty, and risk for candidate microscope operations. For amplitude-modulation scanning probe microscopy, we realize this framework with a physics-informed encoder of force-distance curves, a deterministic scanner model of cantilever and feedback dynamics, and sparse learned residual corrections. The encoder first recovers scanner-driving descriptors with sub-nanometer accuracy. The calibrated scanner then reproduces typical traces within a few nanometers and identifies operating-point noise amplification as the main source of mismatch. Supplementary phase analysis localizes residual error to the phase channel, which clarifies where added physics is needed. Together, these results establish coupled sample and instrument twins as a practical foundation for predictive microscope operation and autonomous experimental planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种耦合数字孪生框架，将样本孪生和仪器孪生分离并链接，用于预测扫描探针显微镜的操作后果，实现自主实验规划。
AI.motivation: 自动化实验正从闭环优化转向开放决策，需要预测候选操作的后果，因此需要同时建模样本响应和仪器检测两方面的模型。
AI.method: 构建耦合数字孪生框架：样本孪生基于先验知识和测量推断材料状态；仪器孪生捕捉信号形成、反馈动力学和操作约束。两者耦合后估计预期结果、不确定性和风险。在调幅扫描探针显微镜中，采用物理信息编码器、确定性扫描器模型和稀疏学习残差校正实现。
AI.result: 编码器以亚纳米精度恢复扫描器驱动描述符；校准后的扫描器能重现典型痕迹（误差在几纳米内），并识别出操作点噪声放大是失配的主要来源；相位分析将残差误差定位到相位通道，指明需要补充物理机制的位置。
AI.conclusion: 耦合样本和仪器孪生为预测性显微镜操作和自主实验规划提供了实用基础。

title: Microscopic theory of the lower critical field in superconducting thin-film strips
summary: The lower critical field \(B_{c1}\) of a narrow superconducting thin-film strip sets the thermodynamic scale for vortex-free operation in a perpendicular magnetic field. The standard Pearl--London estimate requires a phenomenological vortex-core cutoff, because the London theory does not resolve the core. We formulate a microscopic theory for a dirty strip by solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations in the film plane, with the applied field included directly in the gauge-invariant momentum. Self-consistent vortex and Meissner solutions are computed at fixed field, and \(B_{c1}\) is obtained from their Gibbs-energy difference. The calculation resolves the vortex core and its finite-width deformation without introducing a cutoff. The resulting vortex self-energy is larger than the naive Pearl--London estimate and cannot, in general, be represented by a London logarithm with a single width-independent cutoff. The formulation applies at any \(T<T_c\) and provides a microscopic basis for predicting \(B_{c1}\) in superconducting nanostrips and related thin-film devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过求解二维Usadel方程，发展了一种无需引入涡旋核心截断的微观理论，用于计算窄超导薄膜条带在垂直磁场中的下临界场 \(B_{c1}\)，发现涡旋自能大于Pearl-London估计值，且无法用单一宽度无关的截断参数表示。
AI.motivation: 标准Pearl-London估计需要唯象的涡旋核心截断参数，因为London理论无法解析核心结构。作者希望发展一种无需截断的微观理论，准确计算 \(B_{c1}\)。
AI.method: 在薄膜平面内求解二维Usadel方程，将外加场直接纳入规范不变动量中。在固定磁场下自洽计算涡旋态和Meissner态解，通过两者Gibbs自由能差得到 \(B_{c1}\)。
AI.result: 涡旋自能大于简单的Pearl-London估计值，且无法用单一宽度无关的London对数截断表示。该方法适用于任意 \(T<T_c\)。
AI.conclusion: 该微观理论为预测超导纳米条带及相关薄膜器件的 \(B_{c1}\) 提供了微观基础，无需引入唯象截断参数。

title: Modern view of activated rate processes: unidirectional fluxes at equilibrium, correlation functions, and splitting probabilities
summary: More than 80 years ago Kramers published a paper calculating how fast a Brownian particle escapes from a potential well over an activation barrier. Since then Kramers' model has been widely adopted by nuclear physics, biophysics and chemical physics communities as a description of activated barrier crossing. From a chemical kinetics perspective, Kramers' theory provides a mapping from continuous dynamics to discrete-state chemical kinetics. Motivated by recent developments, this Perspective provides a rigorous way of performing such a mapping, explaining why and how Kramers' theory works from several points of view. Specifically, we consider transitions of a Brownian particle between two potential wells corresponding to the ``reactant'' and the ``product'' of a chemical reaction. A central unifying idea is to divide the equilibrium ensemble of possible states of the system into two sub-ensembles corresponding to the reactant and product states and then to consider fluxes between these sub-ensembles. Importantly, naive separation based on the location measured relative to the barrier top does not result in a mapping that is physically tenable, and instead the past of the trajectory should be considered. Thus constructed reactant and product ensembles provide an internally consistent description of the problem when also viewed from two different perspectives: one based on the definition of the rate as a conditional transition probability per unit time and the other based on the relaxation modes of the time-evolution operator governing the dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文对Kramers逾垒理论进行了严格的形式化重构，提出基于轨迹历史（而非瞬时位置）划分反应物与产物子集的方法，为连续布朗动力学到离散化学动力学的映射提供了自洽的理论框架。
AI.motivation: Kramers逾垒模型在核物理、生物物理和化学物理中被广泛应用，但其从连续动力学到离散态化学动力学的映射缺乏严格性。近期的理论进展促使作者提供一个严谨的映射方法，解释Kramers理论为何有效以及如何运作。
AI.method: 将系统平衡态分为反应物与产物两个子集，关键创新在于：不能简单根据粒子相对于势垒顶部的位置划分，而必须考虑轨迹的历史信息。然后从两个视角审视该划分：(1) 将速率定义为条件转移概率；(2) 基于时间演化算子的弛豫模式分析。
AI.result: 基于轨迹历史的子集划分能够提供内部自洽的描述，在两种视角下均得到一致结果；而基于瞬时位置的朴素划分在物理上不可行。
AI.conclusion: Kramers理论可以通过考虑轨迹历史的方式得到严格的形式化证明，这为理解逾垒过程中的反应速率提供了更坚实的基础。

title: Equivalence between the Axion Invariant and the $S_4$ Symmetry Indicator
summary: The equivalence between the axion invariant and the $S_4$ symmetry indicator is established for three-dimensional $S_4$-symmetric axion insulators with vanishing three-dimensional Chern numbers. Starting from the Chern-Simons expression for the magnetoelectric polarizability, $2P_3=θ/π$ is rewritten in terms of the $S_4$ sewing matrix. After stable reduction to determinant-one two-band blocks, the invariant is expressed as the degree of a map from the Brillouin zone to $SU(2)$. The degree modulo two is then evaluated from the $S_4$ eigenvalues at the four $S_4$-invariant momenta and is shown to coincide with the symmetry indicator $z_2$. A minimal tight-binding model verifies the correspondence between $2P_3$ and $z_2$. The result closes a gap between the topological-field-theory description of the axion response and the topological-band-theory classification by symmetry indicators. It also extends the known response-indicator equivalence from antiunitary settings such as $C_nT$ symmetry to the unitary, orientation-reversing rotoinversion symmetry $S_4$.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了三维$S_4$对称轴子绝缘体中轴子不变量与$S_4$对称性指标$z_2$之间的等价性，通过数学推导和紧束缚模型验证，弥合了拓扑场论描述与拓扑能带理论分类之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在建立轴子响应（由磁电极化率$2P_3=\theta/\pi$描述）与对称性指标$z_2$之间的严格等价关系，填补拓扑场论与拓扑能带理论在轴子绝缘体分类上的空白，并将已知的反幺正对称性（如$C_nT$）下的等价关系推广到幺正的、定向反转的旋转反演对称性$S_4$。
AI.method: 从Chern-Simons形式的磁电极化率表达式出发，将$2P_3=\theta/\pi$用$S_4$缝纫矩阵重新表达；通过稳定归约到行列式为1的两带块，将不变量表示为从布里渊区到$SU(2)$的映射度；从四个$S_4$不变动量点处的$S_4$本征值计算模2的映射度，证明其与对称性指标$z_2$一致；最后用最小紧束缚模型验证$2P_3$与$z_2$的对应关系。
AI.result: 成功证明了在三维Chern数为零的条件下，$S_4$对称轴子绝缘体的轴子不变量$2P_3$与对称性指标$z_2$等价。这一等价性通过$S_4$缝纫矩阵的数学变换和模2映射度计算得到严格推导，并由紧束缚模型数值验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了拓扑场论中轴子响应描述与对称性指标拓扑能带分类之间的理论鸿沟，并将响应-指标等价关系从反幺正对称性（如$C_nT$）成功推广到幺正的、定向反转的旋转反演对称性$S_4$。

title: Reaction Pathway Detection using Machine-Learned Energy Potentials -- Decomposition of Energized CF$_3$CHOO
summary: Characterization of the decomposition products of energized Criegee intermediates is essential for assessing their impact on the chemical evolution of the atmosphere. Here, a generic and microscopically resolved approach is used to determine the molecular fragmentation pathways and products for CF$_3$CHOO. They include, among others, direct formation of CO$_2$ + CHF$_3$ (HFC-23), HF + CO$_2$ + CF$_2$, and fragmentation routes that are not evident from static reaction path calculations alone. The computed probability for formation of HFC-23 of 14 \% qualitatively agrees with a value of $(7.9^{+0.4}_{-0.2})$ \% from recent measurements, given the differences in the two approaches. Non-statistical dynamics is found for almost all decomposition pathways and the simulations show that excess energy can redirect reaction outcomes away from minimum-energy pathways. The results highlight the power of machine-learned PESs to elucidate multi-step reaction mechanisms of atmospherically relevant intermediates beyond traditional Master equation/electronic structure approaches to provide molecular-level understanding of the role of dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文使用机器学习势能面模拟了CF₃CHOO（克里奇中间体）的分解过程，揭示了包括HFC-23（14%）在内的多种产物通道，发现非统计动力学效应显著影响反应路径。
AI.motivation: 理解激发态克里奇中间体分解产物对评估大气化学演化至关重要，传统静态反应路径计算可能遗漏重要碎片化通道。
AI.method: 采用机器学习势能面（ML-PES）结合分子动力学模拟的普适性微观分辨率方法，从原子层面追踪CF₃CHOO的分子碎片化路径。
AI.result: 1) 发现多种产物通道，包括直接生成CO₂+CHF₃(HFC-23)、HF+CO₂+CF₂等；2) HFC-23生成概率14%，与实验值(7.9⁺⁰.⁴₋₀.₂)%定性一致；3) 几乎所有分解路径均表现出非统计动力学行为，过剩能量可偏离最小能量路径。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习势能面方法能够超越传统主方程/电子结构方法，揭示大气相关中间体的多步反应机制，提供动态过程的分子级理解。

title: CE-antiferromagnetic electronic structure in LaSr$_2$Mn$_2$O$_7$ revealed by micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and tight-binding models
summary: We have investigated the electronic structure of LaSr$_2$Mn$_2$O$_7$ in the CE-type antiferromagnetic (CE-AFM) state below the Néel temperature using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy ($μ$-ARPES) and tight-binding models. In agreement with the tight-binding calculations, we found a dispersive intensity around the X point in the $μ$-ARPES spectra, where the A-type antiferromagnetic (A-AFM) phase has no bands experimentally and theoretically, demonstrating that we have successfully captured the signatures of the CE-AFM band structure for the first time. Many observed features can be explained by the CE-AFM tight-binding bands, although some of them and the overall near-Fermi level intensity mapping can be explained by the A-AFM band structure. This indicates that the CE-AFM domain size would be no larger than the beam footprint size of a $\sim\!20$~{\textmu}m scale.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱（μ-ARPES）和紧束缚模型，首次成功捕捉到LaSr₂Mn₂O₇在CE型反铁磁态下的能带结构特征，发现其能带特征与紧束缚计算吻合，且CE-AFM畴区尺寸不超过~20微米束斑大小。
AI.motivation: 探究LaSr₂Mn₂O₇在CE型反铁磁态下的电子结构，此前A-AFM相已被研究，但CE-AFM相的能带结构尚未被实验观测到。
AI.method: 使用微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱（μ-ARPES）实验测量，结合紧束缚模型理论计算，对比CE-AFM与A-AFM两种磁有序态的能带特征。
AI.result: 在X点附近观测到与紧束缚计算一致的色散强度，而A-AFM相在该点无能带；多数特征可由CE-AFM能带解释，但部分近费米能级特征需用A-AFM能带解释，表明CE-AFM畴区尺寸不超过~20微米。
AI.conclusion: 首次实验观测到CE-AFM态的特征能带结构，证实了该体系中CE-AFM与A-AFM畴区共存，且CE-AFM畴区尺寸受限于实验束斑大小。

title: Efficient Bethe-Salpeter Equation Calculations Based on Numerical Atomic Orbitals and Norm-Conserving Pseudopotentials: Dual-${\boldsymbol k}$-Mesh Strategy
summary: We present an efficient implementation of the Bethe--Salpeter equation (BSE) based on numerical atomic orbitals (NAOs) and norm-conserving pseudopotentials within the ABACUS+LibRPA framework. By exploiting the localized resolution-of-identity (LRI) technique, the screened Coulomb interaction is cast into a real-space, unit-cell-indexed form $W_{μν}(\boldsymbol R)$ that is inherently short-ranged and well localized. This spatial locality enables an efficient Fourier interpolation of the BSE kernel from the coarse $\boldsymbol k$-mesh used in the preceding $GW$ calculation to an arbitrarily dense $\boldsymbol k$-mesh on which the BSE Hamiltonian is assembled and diagonalized, thereby giving rise naturally to a dual-$\boldsymbol k$-mesh workflow. Building on this scheme, we systematically examine the convergence of the absorption spectra with respect to the NAO basis set, the auxiliary basis set, and the $\boldsymbol k$-point sampling. Benchmark calculations for both molecular and periodic systems collectively validate the accuracy of the present implementation and establish the dual-$\boldsymbol k$-mesh strategy as a practical and reliable approach for $GW$+BSE calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文基于ABACUS+LibRPA框架，实现了数值原子轨道和赝势下的Bethe-Salpeter方程高效计算，利用局域分辨率恒等技术将屏蔽库仑相互作用转化为实空间短程形式，从而自然地实现双k网格工作流，并通过基准测试验证了该方法的准确性和实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有的GW+BSE计算在k点采样上存在计算瓶颈，需要发展一种高效的方法来实现从粗k网格到密k网格的插值，以降低计算成本的同时保证精度。
AI.method: 基于数值原子轨道和模守恒赝势，利用局域分辨率恒等(LRI)技术将屏蔽库仑相互作用表示为实空间短程形式W_{μν}(R)，利用其空间局域性实现BSE核从粗k网格到任意密k网格的傅里叶插值，形成双k网格工作流。
AI.result: 系统检验了吸收谱对NAO基组、辅助基组和k点取样的收敛性，分子和周期性体系的基准计算共同验证了该实现的准确性，确立了双k网格策略作为GW+BSE计算实用可靠的方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用LRI技术实现的双k网格工作流是一种实用且可靠的GW+BSE计算方法，可有效降低计算成本而不损失精度。

title: Decoupling Josephson Coupling and Supercurrent Nonreciprocity in Twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 van der Waals Junctions
summary: The microscopic origin of supercurrent nonreciprocity in van der Waals Josephson junctions remains under active debate, particularly regarding the role of twist-angle engineering in layered superconductors. Here, we investigate superconducting transport in twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 vertical Josephson junctions fabricated by dry transfer with controlled crystallographic alignment and chemically clean interfaces. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy is employed to directly determine the twist angle and assess interface quality. While the Josephson coupling strength exhibits a pronounced dependence on twist angle, with characteristic voltages maximized near crystallographically equivalent orientations and suppressed at intermediate angles, the supercurrent diode efficiency remains negligibly small and shows no systematic twist-angle dependence. In contrast, enhanced diode-like responses emerge only in weakly coupled junctions exhibiting interfacial disorder and reduced transparency. Deliberate interface degradation further amplifies the apparent nonreciprocity, yielding diode efficiencies approaching 30% together with an irregular magnetic-field-strength dependence. These results establish a clear decoupling between Josephson coupling and supercurrent nonreciprocity in twisted NbSe2/NbSe2 junctions. Our findings identify interface disorder, rather than twist-angle-controlled momentum matching, as the dominant origin of the observed diode response and provide a critical benchmark for interpreting nonreciprocal superconducting transport in van der Waals Josephson devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验证明，在扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂垂直约瑟夫森结中，超电流二极管效应并非源于扭转角调控的动量匹配，而是由界面无序和透射率降低主导，实现了约30%的二极管效率，并揭示了约瑟夫森耦合与超电流非互易性之间的清晰解耦。
AI.motivation: 澄清范德华约瑟夫森结中超电流非互易性的微观起源，特别是扭转角工程在其中的作用——这一领域目前仍存在激烈争议。
AI.method: 通过干法转移制备具有受控晶向对准和化学洁净界面的扭曲NbSe₂/NbSe₂垂直约瑟夫森结，利用高分辨透射电镜直接测定扭转角并评估界面质量，系统测量约瑟夫森耦合强度与超电流二极管效率。
AI.result: 约瑟夫森耦合强度在晶向等效取向附近最大化、中间角度被抑制，但二极管效率极小且无系统扭转角依赖性；仅在弱耦合（界面无序、透射率低）的结中出现增强的二极管响应；故意劣化界面后非互易性进一步放大，效率可达~30%，且伴随不规则的磁场依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 界面无序是观测到的二极管响应的主导成因，而非扭转角控制的动量匹配；约瑟夫森耦合与超电流非互易性在扭曲NbSe₂结中被清晰解耦，为解释范德华约瑟夫森器件中的非互易超导输运提供了关键基准。

title: The Ramsey community number as a renormalization-group crossing
summary: The Ramsey community number $r_k$ is the smallest size at which a network is better described by communities than by none, under a Bayesian detection rule. On the diamond hierarchical lattice we show that $r_k$ is an exact renormalization-group crossing: the block-model sufficient statistics obey a linear map with eigenvalues $\{bs,b\}$, the degree-corrected evidence density flows to $\ln K$ at a community fixed point, and $r_k$ is the generation at which the running evidence clears the detection threshold. Degree correction advances detection by two generations. We derive $r_k(b,s;q)$ in closed form for the whole family. Finally, placing on the lattice the Reichardt--Bornholdt community Hamiltonian -- whose ground state is the partition itself -- we find an exact community-ordered phase: below the ferromagnetic critical temperature the two hubs lock into opposite communities for any resolution $γ>0$, a staggered order that persists as $n\to\infty$. Allowing each nested sub-community its own label, the optimal partition is a hierarchy of $q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}$ communities, so the number of Potts states that best describes the network grows with the network. This hierarchy orders thermally level by level, through a cascade of first-order transitions whose temperatures fall as $1/\ln q$, so every stable level persists as $n\to\infty$: the emergent partition is detectable, optimal, and thermodynamically ordered.

AI.tldr: 本文在钻石层级格点上研究了Ramsey社区数 $r_k$，证明了它是一个精确的重整化群交叉点，并推导了其闭式表达式。同时发现Reichardt-Bornholdt哈密顿量在该格点上存在精确的社区有序相，最优分区呈现层级结构，社区数量随网络规模增长而增长。
AI.motivation: 作者希望通过解析方法研究社区检测中的相变行为，特别是Ramsey社区数 $r_k$ 在层级网络中的精确行为，以及社区有序相是否存在精确解。
AI.method: 在钻石层级格点上，利用重整化群分析，研究块模型充分统计量的线性映射（特征值为 $\{bs,b\}$），分析度校正证据密度的流行为，推导 $r_k(b,s;q)$ 的闭式表达式，并通过Reichardt-Bornholdt哈密顿量研究社区有序相。
AI.result: 1) $r_k$ 是精确的重整化群交叉点；2) 度校正可将检测提前两个世代；3) 推导了 $r_k(b,s;q)$ 的闭式表达式；4) 发现了精确的社区有序相，低于铁磁临界温度时两个枢纽锁定为相反社区；5) 最优分区是层级结构，社区数量 $q_{\rm opt}\sim\sqrt{n}$；6) 层级通过一系列一级相变在热学上逐级有序化。
AI.conclusion: 在钻石层级格点上，社区检测存在严格的解析描述：Ramsey社区数可精确计算，社区有序相严格存在，且最优分区是层级式的，其热力学有序性在 $n\to\infty$ 时依然保持稳定。

title: Engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in artificial spin ice via vertex dipolar control
summary: Artificial spin ice (ASI), composed of geometrically frustrated arrays of interacting nanoislands, provides a versatile platform for reprogrammable magnonic functionality. However, the commonly used geometric control parameters such as island length, width, and aspect ratio simultaneously modify the island footprint, inter island dipolar spacing, and shape anisotropy, making it difficult to tune the nonlinear response independently of the linear spectrum and lattice density. Using micromagnetic simulations of kagome ASI under strong microwave drive, we identify edge curvature as a geometric degree of freedom that separates nonlinear magnon scattering from the island footprint. Sharp tipped islands predominantly generate integer harmonics, whereas dumbbell shaped tips produce a transition toward subharmonic rich spectra by concentrating demagnetizing and exchange fields near the island ends without changing the overall island volume or lattice spacing. By mapping the curvature and drive parameter space, we identify a continuous threshold for subharmonic onset controlled by tip curvature. We further show that the angular dependence of the second harmonic amplitude reverses between sharp and dumbbell geometries, providing an experimentally accessible signature of curvature localized nonlinearity. Width and leg length asymmetry can also modify harmonic amplitudes, but they do not remove the intrinsic trade off between footprint and coupling. These results establish tip curvature as a footprint preserving design parameter for engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in ASI, with implications for reconfigurable magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微磁模拟发现，在Kagome人工自旋冰（ASI）中，岛边缘曲率（尖端形状）可作为独立于岛占地面积和晶格密度的几何自由度，调控非线性磁振子散射：尖锐尖端产生整数谐波，哑铃形尖端产生亚谐波，且曲率控制亚谐波激发阈值，为可重构磁振子器件提供了新的设计参数。
AI.motivation: 传统ASI调控参数（长度、宽度、长宽比）会同时改变岛占地面积、偶极间距和形状各向异性，导致难以独立调控非线性响应与线性谱及晶格密度。因此需要寻找一种不影响占地面积和晶格密度的新几何控制自由度。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟方法，对Kagome ASI在强微波驱动下的非线性响应进行研究，系统改变岛边缘曲率（从尖锐到哑铃形），并映射曲率与驱动参数空间，分析谐波产生模式及角度依赖关系。

title: Economised path integrals
summary: The Hessian of the ring polymer spring potential in the standard Trotter path integral is a $P\times P$ symmetric circulant matrix with a centroid eigenvalue of zero. All such matrices commute and are diagonalised by the same bead to normal mode transformation matrix, and their eigenvalues contain $\lceil P/2\rceil-1$ degenerate pairs by symmetry. However, this still leaves some freedom to improve on the Trotter approximation: one can optimise the remaining $\lfloor P/2\rfloor$ independent non-zero normal mode frequencies to fit the exact quantum mechanical radii of gyration of harmonic ring polymers with frequencies in the range $0\leω\leω_{\rm max}$, where $ω_{\rm max}$ is the maximum physical frequency in the problem of interest. The optimisation involves solving a simple least squares problem for the optimum (economised or "Eco") internal mode frequencies. The remainder of the calculation then proceeds in the same way as a Trotter path integral calculation. An example application to hexagonal ice shows that the convergence of the Eco path integral is comparable to that of the 4th order Suzuki-Chin path integral, but with purely 2nd order Trotter effort. There is no need to calculate the projected Hessians that arise in the Suzuki-Chin method by finite differences, there is no need to develop any new estimators for observables, and once the Eco frequencies have been calculated the implementation of the Eco path integral involves changing just a few lines of a Trotter path integral code. To provide a more impressive example we have implemented the Eco method in GPUMD and used it to converge the (negative) thermal expansion coefficient and the constant pressure heat capacity of MOF-5 with a machine-learned neuroevolution potential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种Eco路径积分方法，通过优化环聚合物弹簧势的非零简正模频率来改进Trotter近似，在保持二阶Trotter计算量的情况下达到接近四阶Suzuki-Chin路径积分的收敛精度，并在六角冰和MOF-5等材料的热力学性质计算中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准的Trotter路径积分在计算量子力学性质时收敛速度较慢，而高阶方法（如Suzuki-Chin）虽然收敛更快但实现复杂、需要计算投影Hessian矩阵。作者希望在保持二阶Trotter方法简单性的同时，提高其收敛效率。
AI.method: 利用环聚合物弹簧势的Hessian矩阵是循环对称矩阵的特性，通过优化⌊P/2⌋个独立的非零简正模频率，使其拟合量子谐振子回旋半径的精确解，将优化转化为简单的最小二乘问题。优化后的"Eco"频率替换原有频率后，其余计算流程与标准Trotter路径积分完全相同。
AI.result: 在六角冰的测试中，Eco路径积分的收敛性与四阶Suzuki-Chin路径积分相当，但仅需二阶Trotter的计算量。在MOF-5的热膨胀系数和定压热容计算中，Eco方法成功收敛了负热膨胀系数，展现了在复杂材料体系中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: Eco路径积分方法兼具二阶Trotter方法的简单易实现性和接近高阶方法的收敛速度，只需改动几行代码即可从现有Trotter代码迁移，无需开发新的观测算符或计算投影Hessian，是一种实用高效的量子热力学模拟改进方案。

title: Bose Einstein Condensation of Magnons in BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$: An experimental perspective
comment: 29 pages, 14 figures, to be published as Chapter 5 in the Springer book "Dimerized Quantum Magnets -Quantum Phase Transitions and Elementary Excitations-" edited by H. Tanaka and M. Matsumoto
summary: Han Purple, a pigment first obtained in ancient China, is one of the earliest known synthetic pigments. Also naturally occurring, as a mineral, it is known as colinowensite (Cwn). Its chemical formula is BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$, and its structure is a layered cyclosilicate in which magnetic Cu$^{2+}$ ions (S = 1/2) form dimers arranged on a square lattice, making it also the first known synthetic metal dimer compound. Most interesting magnetic properties arise from a strong intradimer spin coupling, accompanied by weaker interdimer interactions within and between Cu-dimer layers. In zero or small magnetic fields, BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$ remains a quantum paramagnet. However, under high magnetic fields between 23 and 49 Tesla -- about a million times stronger than Earth's magnetic field -- it undergoes magnetic ordering at subliquid Helium temperatures into an almost ideal easy-plane (XY) antiferromagnetic state regarded as a realization of a Bose-Einstein condensate of magnons. Within this experimentally accessible field range, BaCuSi$_{2}$O$_{6}$ serves as an extraordinary playground for testing predictions of quantum many-body physics.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了汉紫（BaCuSi₂O₆）作为一种最早合成颜料的同时，也是一种重要的量子磁性材料。在强磁场（23-49特斯拉）和极低温下，它进入一种近乎理想的XY型反铁磁有序态，被视为磁振子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，为量子多体物理提供了珍贵的实验平台。
AI.motivation: 汉紫（BaCuSi₂O₆）不仅是一种古老的人工合成颜料，其独特的层状硅酸盐结构使Cu²⁺离子形成二聚体并排列在四方格子上，展现出丰富的量子磁性现象。研究旨在揭示其在强磁场下的磁有序行为及其作为量子多体物理实验平台的潜力。
AI.method: 通过分析BaCuSi₂O₆的晶体结构（层状环硅酸盐，Cu²⁺二聚体呈四方格子排列），结合强磁场（23-49特斯拉）和极低温（亚液氦温度）实验，研究其从量子顺磁态到反铁磁有序态的转变。
AI.result: 在零场或弱场下为量子顺磁体；在23-49特斯拉强磁场及亚液氦温度下，进入近乎理想的易平面（XY型）反铁磁有序态，该态被解释为磁振子的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体。
