title: Anomalous Piezoelectricity from Polarization-Dependent Electrostriction in Wurtzites
summary: The piezoelectric coefficient is a third-rank tensor connecting the strain or stress with the electric field or polarization, whereas the electrostriction coefficient is a fourth-rank tensor relating the strain to the square of electric polarization. The electrostriction tensor components in the current literature are often treated as constants independent of polarization, resulting in piezoelectric tensor components that are linearly proportional to polarization and the dielectric susceptibility tensor. Here, we study the electrostriction and piezoelectricity in strongly polar wurtzites, including AlN, Al$_{1-x}$Sc$_x$N, Al$_{1-x}$B$_x$N, GaN, and ZnO. We discover that electrostriction and the elastic modulus in wurtzites are both strongly polarization-dependent, and the piezoelectric coefficient is highly nonlinear with respect to polarization, including the anomalous possibility that decreasing polarization increases the electromechanical strain response. These unusual dependencies of electrostriction and piezoelectric effects on polarization arise from the evolution of a layered reference nonpolar structure toward a tetrahedrally coordinated wurtzite network structure as the polarization increases. The findings have important implications in understanding the thermodynamics of the general class of wurtzite ferroelectrics and in manipulating their piezoelectric and ferroelectric behaviors.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了强极性纤锌矿材料（如AlN、AlScN、GaN、ZnO）中电致伸缩系数和弹性模量强烈依赖于极化强度，导致压电系数与极化呈非线性关系，甚至出现极化降低反而增强机电应变响应的反常现象。
AI.motivation: 当前文献常将电致伸缩张量分量视为与极化无关的常数，导致压电张量分量被简单视为与极化和介电 susceptibility 呈线性关系。本文旨在检验这一假设在强极性纤锌矿材料中的有效性。
AI.method: 对强极性纤锌矿材料（AlN、Al₁₋ₓScₓN、Al₁₋ₓBₓN、GaN、ZnO）进行电致伸缩和压电性的理论研究，分析极化强度变化对电致伸缩系数和弹性模量的影响。
AI.result: 发现纤锌矿中电致伸缩系数和弹性模量均强烈依赖极化强度；压电系数与极化呈高度非线性关系，甚至出现极化减小反而增大机电应变响应的反常现象。
AI.conclusion: 这些非寻常依赖关系源于极化增大过程中层状参考非极性结构向四面体配位纤锌矿网络结构演化。该发现对理解纤锌矿铁电体的热力学及调控其压电/铁电行为有重要意义。

title: Anomalously high quasiparticle thermal conductivity in the underdoped cuprate superconductor HgBa$_{2}$CuO$_{4+δ}$
summary: The single-layer cuprate superconductor HgBa$_{2}$CuO$_{4+δ}$ (Hg1201) is an ideal candidate for investigating many properties of cuprates with minimal disorder and without the complication of multiple CuO$_2$ layers. Here we measure the in-plane longitudinal thermal conductivity $κ$ of underdoped Hg1201 ($T_c$ = 76 K, $p$ = 0.11) at dilution refrigerator temperatures to extract the nodal quasiparticle velocity ratio $v_F/v_Δ$. Assuming contributions from only a single line node per quadrant on the Fermi surface leads to a value of $v_F/v_Δ$ = $23 \pm 3$, anomalously large compared to other cuprates at similar dopings. In conjunction with the anomalously high quasiparticle specific heat of Hg1201 in the normal state reported previously at a similar doping, this points to more than one Fermi surface sheet crossing the nodal line, suggesting the presence of more than the single small electron pocket detected by quantum oscillations.

AI.tldr: 文章通过测量欠掺杂Hg1201超导体的低温热导率，提取了节点准粒子速度比v_F/v_Δ，发现该值异常大（23±3），结合正常态异常高的比热，表明费米面存在多个节点线交叉，暗示存在更多电子口袋。
AI.motivation: Hg1201作为单层铜氧化物超导体，是研究铜氧化物本征性质（低无序、无多CuO₂层干扰）的理想体系。作者希望通过测量其低温热导率提取节点速度比，以揭示其费米面结构。
AI.method: 测量欠掺杂Hg1201（Tc=76 K, p=0.11）在稀释制冷机温度下的面内纵向热导率κ，从中提取节点准粒子速度比v_F/v_Δ。
AI.result: 得到v_F/v_Δ = 23 ± 3，显著高于其他铜氧化物在类似掺杂水平的值。
AI.conclusion: 异常大的速度比结合前期报道的正常态高比热，指向费米面上存在多个节线交叉，暗示除量子振荡检测到的一个小电子口袋外，还有更多费米面片。

title: Thermodynamic phase transitions in lattice spin systems with severe kinetic constraints: Numerical simulation results
comment: 38 pages, 10 figures, under review at Physical Review E
summary: The Fredrickson-Andersen model with hyperparameter $K=1$ is a severely constrained kinetic lattice spin system, such that any site is temporarily blocked from changing its packing state (empty or occupied) if there is one or more occupied nearest neighbors. Starting from a completely random initial configuration with a fraction $ρ$ of sites being occupied, some of the sites may be permanently frozen to their initial state under this severe kinetic constraint. The remaining sites can switch states at least occasionally, and they form the unfrozen subsystem associated with the given initial configuration. In the present work we investigate thermodynamic phase transitions in such unfrozen subsystems of the two-dimensional square lattice and the three-dimensional cubic lattice by extensive numerical simulations. We demonstrate that the giant connected component of the unfrozen subsystem collapses at certain critical value $ρ_{c}$ of initial packing density, with $ρ_c = 0.2475$ for the square lattice and $ρ_c = 0.2809$ for the cubic lattice. This phase transition belongs to the same universality class of the conventional site percolation. We also observe that the ground states (densest packing configurations) experience a continuous crystal-to-glass phase transition at the critical value $ρ^* = 0.1423$ of initial packing density for the cubic lattice. For the two-dimensional square lattice we argue that long-range crystalline order is destroyed in the ground states as long as the initial packing density $ρ$ is positive.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Fredrickson-Andersen模型（K=1）在二维正方晶格和三维立方晶格中的热力学相变。发现未冻结子系统的巨连通分量在临界初始密度ρ_c处崩塌（正方晶格ρ_c=0.2475，立方晶格ρ_c=0.2809），该相变属于常规位点逾渗的普适类。此外，立方晶格的基态在ρ^*=0.1423处发生连续晶体-玻璃相变，而二维正方晶格中任何正初始密度都会破坏长程晶序。
AI.motivation: 研究严重约束动力学晶格自旋系统中未冻结子系统的热力学相变行为，特别是其逾渗转变和基态相变，以理解强约束条件下的有序-无序转变机制。
AI.method: 通过大规模数值模拟，对二维正方晶格和三维立方晶格中Fredrickson-Andersen模型（K=1）的未冻结子系统进行逾渗分析和基态结构分析。
AI.result: 未冻结子系统的巨连通分量在临界密度ρ_c处崩塌：正方晶格ρ_c=0.2475，立方晶格ρ_c=0.2809，该相变属于常规位点逾渗普适类。立方晶格基态在ρ^*=0.1423处发生连续晶体-玻璃相变。二维正方晶格中，任何正初始密度均破坏长程晶序。
AI.conclusion: Fredrickson-Andersen模型（K=1）的未冻结子系统表现出与常规位点逾渗相同的临界行为，同时在三维情况下存在晶体-玻璃相变，表明强动力学约束下的系统仍可展现丰富的相变现象。

title: Identifying Non-Ideal Reaction-Diffusion Systems Unable to Maintain Diffusion Out-of-Equilibrium
summary: We develop a general method, based on the construction of a kinetic potential acting as a Lyapunov function, to establish when diffusion necessarily equilibrates in non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems, under arbitrary driving by autonomous homogeneous chemostats. Using this method, we generalize the results of J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024) by relaxing some of the underlying assumptions. Specifically, we show that diffusion equilibrates in reaction-diffusion systems whose chemical reaction network is either pseudo-detailed balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled by the stoichiometry of reactants and products, or complex balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled only by the stoichiometry of the reactants. The different constraints on the reaction fluxes are shown to originate from the distinct stoichiometric properties of the two classes of networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于动能势（作为Lyapunov函数）的通用方法，用于判定非理想反应-扩散系统在任意自治均匀化学恒化器驱动下是否必然达到扩散平衡。该方法推广了J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024)的结果，放宽了部分假设条件。研究表明，当化学反应网络满足伪细致平衡（反应通量由反应物和产物的化学计量控制）或复平衡（反应通量仅由反应物的化学计量控制）时，扩散会趋于平衡。这两类反应通量约束的差异源于网络不同的化学计量特性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究(J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108, 2024)对反应-扩散系统中扩散平衡的条件有初步结果，但假设条件较为严格。作者希望发展一种更通用的方法，在放宽假设的前提下，系统性地判定非理想反应-扩散系统在恒化器驱动下扩散何时必然达到平衡。
AI.method: 通过构造一个动能势（kinetic potential）作为Lyapunov函数，分析反应-扩散系统的动力学稳定性。将化学反应网络分为两类——伪细致平衡网络（反应通量受反应物和产物化学计量控制）和复平衡网络（反应通量仅受反应物化学计量控制），分别推导扩散平衡条件。
AI.result: 成功建立了一种通用判定方法，证明了两类网络（伪细致平衡网络和复平衡网络）在非理想反应-扩散系统中均能实现扩散平衡，并阐明了这两类网络对反应通量施加的不同约束源于化学计量特性的差异。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造Lyapunov函数（动能势）的方法，有效地推广了先前研究的结论，为非理想反应-扩散系统中扩散平衡的判定提供了更普适的理论框架。不同类别的化学反应网络对反应通量的约束机制差异可归因于化学计量特性的不同。

title: Floquet polaritons in optically driven materials
summary: Polaritons are coupled collective modes of light and matter in quantum materials. In modern pump-probe experiments, a pump light pulse may dramatically alter the properties of the polaritons, rendering them Floquet polaritons that can be detected by a probe pulse. We present a practical framework to describe Floquet polaritons in terms of the linear and nonlinear optical properties of the material. The central quantity that yields the spectra of Floquet polaritons is an effective linear optical susceptibility contributed by the pump through nonlinear optical susceptibilities. We apply this method to graphene and show that via its third-order optical nonlinearity, infrared pump leads to Floquet plasmon bands. Notably, near plasmonic band crossings, parametric instability leads to flat bands with unstable modes and exceptional points that closely resemble those of non-Hermitian systems. As a second example, we show that in hexagonal boron nitride pumped by mid-infrared laser, the pump induces Floquet phonon polariton bands via phononic nonlinearity, which can be detected with either far-field or near-field optical technique. Finally, in layered superconductors pumped by THz light polarized along the out-of-plane direction, the Josephson-type optical nonlinearity leads to Floquet Josephson plasmons, which manifest as new peaks in the THz reflectivity of a probe pulse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了描述Floquet极化子的实用理论框架，通过有效线性光化率（由泵浦光经非线性光化率贡献）来刻画泵浦-探测实验中形成的Floquet极化子光谱。作者将方法应用于石墨烯、六方氮化硼和层状超导体三个体系，分别展示了泵浦诱导的Floquet等离激元带、声子极化子带和约瑟夫森等离激元，并发现了平带、非厄米例外点等新奇现象。
AI.motivation: 现代泵浦-探测实验中，强泵浦光会剧烈改变材料中极化子（光-物质耦合集体模式）的性质，形成Floquet极化子。目前缺乏一个统一且实用的理论框架来描述这类Floquet极化子及其光谱特征，因此本文旨在建立这样一个框架。
AI.method: 提出一个实用理论框架，将Floquet极化子的光谱归结为一个有效线性光化率——该化率由泵浦光通过材料的非线性光化率贡献得到。通过这一框架，将泵浦诱导的极化子改性问题转化为常规的线性响应计算。
AI.result: 1) 石墨烯中：红外泵浦通过三阶光学非线性诱导出Floquet等离激元带，在带交叉附近出现参量不稳定性导致的平带、非厄米系统的例外点等特征。2) 六方氮化硼中：中红外泵浦通过声子非线性诱导出Floquet声子极化子带，可用远场或近场光学技术探测。3) 层状超导体中：THz面外偏振泵浦通过约瑟夫森型光学非线性诱导出Floquet约瑟夫森等离激元，在探测THz反射谱中出现新峰。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架具有普适性，可以描述多种材料体系中泵浦光对极化子模式的Floquet调控，为理解和设计光诱导的量子材料新物态提供了理论工具。

title: An entropic bottleneck, dynamical gating, and outward redistribution of roaming in a designed Chesnavich-type model
summary: Roaming reactions are organized not by potential-energy saddles but by transition states that are unstable invariant objects in phase space, periodic orbits in the two degrees of freedom studied here. To ask what controls roaming, we modify the Chesnavich model of a barrierless ion--molecule dissociation: its orientation-dependent angular hindrance is replaced by a transverse-stiffness ridge whose angular frequency peaks at an interior radius, and the classical dynamics are studied at a fixed energy just above the dissociation threshold. Comparing two ensembles that differ only in this angular interaction (same radial channel, energy, and inward initial conditions) isolates its effect. The ridge gates entry into the inner well, cutting inner capture from $57\%$ to $15\%$ and returning most of the incoming flux directly to reactants; it does not eliminate roaming but relocates it outward, suppressing it inside the ridge and switching it on farther out. The model retains analogues of the original model's three transition states (tight, free-rotor, and outer orbiting orbits), which we locate as unstable periodic orbits. The tight orbit spans a dividing surface that coincides, within numerical accuracy, with the variational minimum-flux surface, and it carries no barrier along the reaction coordinate: a deep entropic bottleneck placed at an interior radius by the stiffness maximum. Its entropic character is shared with the original model. Strength-matched monotone controls show that the gating tracks the hindrance strength at the bottleneck radius; what the interior maximum supplies is placement, concentrating that strength where it gates most effectively. The trajectories it admits roam nonstatistically, with nonexponential gap-time distributions: the entropic bottleneck governs how much is captured, not the dynamics that follow.

AI.tldr: 本文通过修改Chesnavich离子-分子解离模型，研究了“漫游反应”（roaming reactions）的相空间动力学。研究发现，角向刚度脊（transverse-stiffness ridge）起到了熵瓶颈的作用，控制进入内阱的捕获率，但不影响捕获后的漫游动力学。三种不稳定的周期轨道（紧密、自由转子、外轨道）作为过渡态被识别，其中紧密轨道对应变分最小通量面，形成无势垒的熵瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 探究漫游反应（roaming）的控制机制：传统认为漫游由势能面上的鞍点组织，但作者质疑此观点，提出漫游实际上由相空间中的不稳定不变对象（特别是周期轨道）组织。通过修改Chesnavich模型，隔离角向相互作用的影响，试图回答“什么控制着漫游”这一核心问题。
AI.method: 修改Chesnavich模型：将原来的取向依赖性角向阻碍（angular hindrance）替换为横向刚度脊（transverse-stiffness ridge），其角频率在内半径处达到峰值。在固定能量（略高于解离阈值）下研究经典动力学。比较两个仅在角向相互作用上不同的系综（相同的径向通道、能量和向内初始条件），以隔离角向效应。
AI.result: 1) 刚度脊将内阱捕获率从57%降至15%，大部分入射通量直接返回反应物。2) 漫游并未被消除，而是被重新定位到更远的区域（脊内部被抑制，外部被激活）。3) 识别了三种不稳定周期轨道（紧密、自由转子、外轨道），其中紧密轨道对应的分界面在数值精度内与变分最小通量面重合。4) 紧密轨道沿反应坐标无势垒，但在内半径处由刚度最大值形成深度熵瓶颈。5) 捕获后的漫游动力学呈现非统计行为（非指数间隔时间分布），熵瓶颈控制捕获量而非后续动力学。
AI.conclusion: 漫游反应的组织者是相空间中的不稳定周期轨道，而非势能鞍点。角向刚度脊通过形成熵瓶颈来控制捕获率，但捕获后的动力学是非统计的、由其他因素主导。与强度匹配的单调控制对比表明，瓶颈处的阻碍强度决定了门控效果，而内半径处的峰值提供了最佳的位置布局。这一发现揭示了漫游反应中“捕获控制”与“后续动力学”的分离机制。

title: Weak-coupling altermagnetism and chiral magnetic excitations in a checkerboard lattice
summary: Altermagnets, characterized by spin-split electronic bands with compensated magnetic moments, have emerged as a new class of magnetic materials garnering attention in recent years. Here, using a minimal one-band Hubbard model, we show that the checkerboard lattice serves as a natural platform for altermagnetism for electrons. The instability towards altermagnetic order is denoted by diverging altermagnetic susceptibility at weak-coupling. Carrying out mean-field treatment of the Hubbard repulsion, we show phase transitions from the nonmagnetic to altermagnetic semimetal and then to altermagnetic insulating phase, allowing clear identification of spin-split states. We then examine magnetic excitations in the altermagnetic phases using a random-phase approximation treatment of the dynamical spin susceptibility. The altermagnetic order is found to be stable against spin-fluctuations with the excitation spectra showing well-defined magnon excitations, which decay into single-particle excitations with decreasing interaction strength. Remarkably, the magnetic excitations exhibit strong dependence on both chirality and direction, showing an alternating chirality splitting, similar to the alternating spin splitting of the electronic bands, which serves as a salient feature of altermagnetism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过最小单带Hubbard模型，证明棋盘格晶格是产生交变磁性的自然平台；通过平均场和随机相位近似分析，揭示了从非磁到交变磁半金属再到绝缘体的相变，并发现磁激发具有手性和方向依赖的交变分裂特征。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体作为一种兼具自旋分裂能带和补偿磁矩的新型磁性材料，近年来受到广泛关注，但对其基本物理机制和微观平台的理解尚不充分，需要进一步探索。
AI.method: 采用最小单带Hubbard模型，通过计算交变磁化率判断弱耦合不稳定性；利用平均场理论处理Hubbard排斥相互作用以描述相变；采用随机相位近似处理动力学自旋磁化率，分析磁激发性质。
AI.result: 棋盘格晶格中的交变磁性不稳定性由发散的交变磁化率表征；平均场分析展示了从非磁相到交变磁半金属相再到交变磁绝缘体相的相变序列；磁激发谱具有明确的磁振子激发，且显示出交替的手性分裂，与电子能带的自旋分裂相对应。
AI.conclusion: 棋盘格晶格是交变磁性的自然平台，交变磁序对自旋涨落保持稳定，磁激发的手性和方向依赖性是其显著特征。

title: Orientation-resolved ultrafast spin reorientation dynamics in ferrimagnetic DyCo$_5$
summary: Under quasi-static conditions, ferrimagnetic DyCo$_5$ thin films exhibit a thermally induced spin-reorientation transition, in which the equilibrium magnetization changes from an out-of-plane to an in-plane orientation, mostly as a result of the competing magnetic anisotropy contributions of the Dy $4f$ rare-earth and Co $3d$ transition-metal sublattices. While this equilibrium transition has been studied, it remains an open question whether such a reorientation can be triggered on ultrafast timescales using femtosecond laser excitation. In this work, we investigate the ultrafast spin-reorientation dynamics in DyCo$_5$. The time-dependent orientation of the magnetization vector following femtosecond laser excitation is quantified by combining polar with transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements in the extreme ultraviolet spectral range, which are sensitive to the out-of-plane and in-plane magnetization component, respectively. Both techniques are implemented at the Co M$_{3,2}$ resonance and are complemented by visible-light MOKE measurements. This combined approach allows us to resolve the canting of the magnetization from an out-of-plane toward an in-plane orientation and to determine the characteristic timescales of the transient spin-reorientation process.

AI.tldr: 本文利用飞秒激光激发并结合极紫外与可见光波段磁光克尔效应，首次实验证实了DyCo₅薄膜中可发生超快自旋重取向，并定量解析了磁化矢量从面外转向面内的动态过程及其特征时间尺度。
AI.motivation: 此前仅研究了DyCo₅的热平衡自旋重取向转变，尚不清楚是否能在飞秒时间尺度上通过激光激发触发这一重取向过程。
AI.method: 结合极紫外波段的极向与横向磁光克尔效应（分别敏感于面外和面内磁化分量），辅以可见光MOKE测量，均在Co M₃,₂共振处实施，从而解析磁化矢量的瞬态倾斜角度与时序演化。
AI.result: 成功观测到磁化从面外转向面内的瞬态倾斜，并确定了超快自旋重取向过程的特征时间尺度。
AI.conclusion: 飞秒激光激发可以在DyCo₅中诱导超快自旋重取向，为理解和控制稀土-过渡金属体系中的超快磁化动力学提供了新的途径。

title: Effect of charge-imbalance potential relaxation on the high-frequency vortex dynamics and kinetic inductance of superconducting circuits
summary: We show that relaxation of the charge-imbalance potential plays a key role in the retarded dynamics of Abrikosov vortices in a type-II superconducting sample carrying a microwave current. Starting from the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations we derive the vortex equation of motion accounting both the dissipation and retardation effects. The retardation is governed by the dynamics of the charge-imbalance potential and reveals itself at characteristic timescales diverging near the superconducting critical temperature $T_{c}$. These retardation effects in vortex dynamics strongly affect the kinetic inductance of superconducting circuits being, thus, responsible for the magnetic field dependence of characteristics of different superconducting devices in the high frequency range.

AI.tldr: 本文证明电荷不平衡势的弛豫在Ⅱ类超导体中Abrikosov涡旋的延迟动力学中起关键作用。从含时Ginzburg-Landau方程出发，推导了同时包含耗散和延迟效应的涡旋运动方程。延迟效应由电荷不平衡势动力学控制，其特征时间尺度在接近超导临界温度Tc时发散。这种延迟效应强烈影响超导电路的动力学电感，因此对高频范围内超导器件的性能有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 揭示电荷不平衡势弛豫在涡旋延迟动力学中的作用，理解其对超导电路高频特性的影响机制。
AI.method: 从含时Ginzburg-Landau方程出发，推导出同时包含耗散和延迟效应的涡旋运动方程。
AI.result: 延迟效应由电荷不平衡势动力学支配；特征时间尺度在接近Tc时发散；延迟效应显著影响超导电路的动力学电感。
AI.conclusion: 电荷不平衡势的弛豫是涡旋延迟动力学的关键机制，对高频超导器件的性能（尤其是动力学电感对磁场的依赖性）有重要影响。

title: Conditional Residence Times and Sequential Transition Dynamics of an Overdamped Dimere
summary: We investigate the completion dynamics of an overdamped dimer moving in a bistable potential under thermal fluctuations and a weak periodic force. Both monomers start in one of the two wells separated by a barrier. The transition is initiated when the monomer closer to the barrier makes a jump across it. The completion dynamics refers to the next part of the dynamics where the second monomer has to wait for some time before it can follow up. We use the Conditional Residence Time (CRT) to study the delay between the successive barrier crossing of the two monomers. The CRT distributions highlight qualitatively different regimes formed by the competition between the escape times of the lagging monomer and the time period of the external drive. The effect is strongest in the weak coupling regime where the delayed completion is spread across multiple forcing cycles. By partitioning this process into three windows, i.e. the immediate, first cycle and later cycles, we show that the probability that the lagging monomer will make a transition in the said cycle is redistributed among these pathways as we change the frequency of the drive. This leads to a non-monotonic dependence of the mean CRT on the frequency of the drive. Our results demonstrate that transition initiation and completion in a coupled system are two separate processes and establish CRT as a useful measure to quantify the sequential barrier crossing dynamics in coupled stochastic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了过阻尼二聚体在双稳势垒中，在热涨落和弱周期力作用下的完成动力学。通过条件驻留时间（CRT）分析两个单体先后跨越势垒的延迟行为，揭示了弱耦合下跨越延迟可跨越多个驱动力周期，且CRT随驱动频率呈非单调变化。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注耦合随机系统中首次跨越势垒的触发过程，但对触发后第二个单体跟随跨越的"完成动力学"缺乏系统理解。本文旨在区分触发与完成这两个过程，并建立CRT作为量化顺序跨越动力学的有效工具。
AI.method: 采用过阻尼朗之万动力学描述二聚体在双稳势中的运动。定义条件驻留时间（CRT）为两个单体先后跨越势垒的时间延迟。将完成过程分为三个窗口（即时、第一个周期、后续周期），分析不同驱动频率下落后单体的跨越概率分布。
AI.result: CRT分布呈现不同定性状态，由落后单体的逃脱时间与外部驱动力周期的竞争决定。弱耦合下效果最强，延迟完成可跨多个驱动力周期。驱动频率变化时，落后单体在各周期窗口的跨越概率重新分布，导致平均CRT随频率非单调变化。
AI.conclusion: 耦合系统中，过渡触发与完成是两个独立的过程。CRT是量化耦合随机系统中顺序跨越势垒动力学的有用指标，揭示了弱周期驱动力下延迟完成的复杂行为。

title: Machine learning prediction of the convergence criterion for a topological invariant of finite non-Hermitian chains
summary: A topological invariant based on polar-decomposition of matrices correctly captures the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains exhibiting the non-Hermitian skin effect, provided that an appropriate crop-length parameter is chosen. This parameter, which sets the cutoff used in the calculation of the invariant, is usually chosen empirically and becomes especially important near topological phase transitions, where finite-size effects are strongest. Here we show that the required crop-length is controlled by physical decay (localization) lengths. For nearest-neighbor and pure longer-range hopping Hatano-Nelson-type chains, the crop-length is set mainly by a single localization length and is well approximated by a scalar multiple of that length. For more general longer-range hopping models, it is governed instead by a multichannel root structure of the characteristic polynomial. Random-forest regression captures finite-size and near-boundary corrections while preserving this decay-length interpretation. Trained on one set of Hamiltonians, the predictor accurately generalizes to unseen Hamiltonians and complex base energies, reproducing crop-lengths across full phase diagrams. We further show that the predictions learned from clean nearest-neighbor hopping chains remain stable under moderate hopping disorder. These results provide a practical and physically interpretable way to choose the crop-length, which in turn determines when the real-space invariant can reliably capture the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非厄米链中拓扑不变量计算所需的裁剪长度参数，发现该长度由物理局域化长度控制，并提出了基于随机森林回归的预测方法，可从已知哈密顿量推广到未知系统。
AI.motivation: 非厄米拓扑系统中，基于极分解的拓扑不变量需要选择合适的裁剪长度参数，但该参数通常凭经验选取，尤其在拓扑相变附近有限尺寸效应显著时难以确定，缺乏物理依据和系统方法。
AI.method: 通过分析Hatano-Nelson型链（最近邻和纯长程跳跃），证明裁剪长度主要由单一局域化长度决定；对更一般的模型，利用特征多项式的多通道根结构描述；采用随机森林回归捕捉有限尺寸和边界修正，并测试了对未见哈密顿量和复杂基能量的泛化能力。
AI.result: 裁剪长度受物理局域化长度控制，在简单模型中可由局域化长度的标量倍数近似；随机森林回归能准确预测裁剪长度，且从干净最近邻跳跃链学到的预测在中等无序下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种实用且物理可解释的裁剪长度选择方法，使得实数空间拓扑不变量能可靠地捕捉有限非厄米链的拓扑性质。

title: Bockstein Braiding Statistics Versus Three-Loop Braiding
summary: Braiding statistics of $p$- and $q$-dimensional topological excitations is conventionally defined in $p+q+2$ spatial dimensions. We find a novel statistical process $W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N$ for two order-$N$ excitations in $p+q+1$ dimensions, detecting the Bockstein response $A\smile β(B)$. This new statistics and fermionic loop statistics exhaust all loop statistics in three dimensions whose fusion rules form an Abelian group $G$, classified by $H^5(B^2G,U(1))$. Surprisingly, conventional three-loop braiding goes beyond this classification, so it must have non-Abelian fusion rules. We suggest viewing three-loop braiding as particle-loop braiding together with exotic fusion rules between loops and point-like defects. We also try to clarify the relationship between statistics and symmetry anomaly.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现了在 p+q+1 维空间中阶数为 N 的激发之间存在一种新的统计过程 W_N，它检测 Bockstein 响应 A∪β(B)，并指出传统三环编织超出了基于阿贝尔融合规则的分类，因此必须具有非阿贝尔融合规则。
AI.motivation: 传统的编织统计通常定义在 p+q+2 维空间中，作者试图探索在 p+q+1 维空间中是否存在新的统计过程，并澄清统计与对称性反常之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过理论分析发现了一种新的统计过程 W_N(X,Y)=(Y^{-1}X^{-1})^N(YX)^N，该过程检测 Bockstein 响应 A∪β(B)，并利用上同调群 H^5(B^2G,U(1)) 对阿贝尔融合规则下的环统计进行分类。
AI.result: 新的统计过程与费米子环统计穷尽了三维空间中所有环统计（融合规则形成阿贝尔群 G 的情况），分类由 H^5(B^2G,U(1)) 给出。传统三环编织超出了该分类，必须有非阿贝尔融合规则。
AI.conclusion: 建议将三环编织视为粒子-环编织与环和点缺陷之间的奇异融合规则的结合，并尝试澄清统计与对称性反常之间的关系。

title: Modelling the mean inner potential of alloyed and strained materials
summary: In this publication, we study the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential (MIP) using density functional theory (DFT) within an augmented plane waves plus local orbitals basis set. Two major effects have been identified allowing to model the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential with a reasonable accuracy. First, alloying for constant volume results in a linear relationship between the MIP and the concentration. Second, the MIP scales with changes in volume as we already pointed out in an earlier publication (M. Schowalter, D. Lamoen, A. Rosenauer, P. Kruse, and D. Gerthsen, Appl. Phys. Lett. 85, 4938-4940 (2004)). Specifically, a linear relationship between MIP and concentration x was found for AlGaAs (nearly no change in lattice parameter), whereas InGaP and GeSi (volume changes with concentration x) exhibits a clear bowing. The bowing can be modeled by taking the rescaling of the MIP with the varying volume additionally into account. The rescaling could be also used to model the dependence of the MIP on strained binary cells and the density dependence of e.g. amorphous materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DFT研究应变和合金化对平均内势(MIP)的影响，发现MIP与浓度呈线性关系，并与体积变化成比例缩放，通过考虑体积重新缩放可建模AlGaAs、InGaP和GeSi等材料的MIP弯曲行为。
AI.motivation: 探究应变和合金化对平均内势(MIP)的影响机制，建立能够合理准确建模这些影响的数学模型。
AI.method: 使用基于增广平面波加局域轨道基组的密度泛函理论(DFT)进行计算分析。
AI.result: 1) 恒定体积下合金化导致MIP与浓度呈线性关系；2) MIP随体积变化呈比例缩放；3) AlGaAs(晶格常数几乎不变)中MIP与浓度x呈线性关系，而InGaP和GeSi(体积随浓度变化)呈现明显的弯曲(bowing)现象。
AI.conclusion: 通过考虑体积重新缩放效应，可以建模合金化MIP的弯曲行为，该方法也可用于建模应变二元胞的MIP依赖关系以及非晶材料中的密度依赖关系。

title: Multi-Knob Switchable Chiral Superconductivity Quartet in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: Chiral superconductors break orbital time-reversal symmetry and may host topological quasiparticles with non-Abelian statistics. In rhombohedral graphene, superconductivity develops from a spin-valley-polarized quarter-metal (QM) parent state and features unique magnetic hysteresis of resistance that indicates orbital time-reversal-symmetry-breaking. Exploring and controlling the full spin-valley flavors of such superconductivity could enable novel superconducting and topological devices, but have remained unexplored. Here we report transport measurements on rhombohedral hexalayer graphene (R6G), which reveal a new superconducting state (SCH) that is induced by an out-of-plane magnetic field, in addition to chiral superconductivity (CSC) similar to those observed in thinner layers. This SCH state emerges above 0.8 T, persists up to 1.6 T and can be switched on/off by magnetic field $H_\perp$, carrier density $n$, and gate displacement field $D$. Quantum oscillations and anomalous Hall measurements show that SCH stems from a field-induced quarter-metal (QM$'$) parent phase, which carries orbital magnetization opposite to that of the zero-field QM. Across the full $(n, D, H_\perp)$ parameter space, superconductivity can be realized from all four spin-valley isospin flavors, establishing a switchable chiral-superconductor quartet in R6G. We interpret the parent-state switching as arising from competition between a Kane-Mele-like spin-valley splitting and magnetic-field coupling to spin-valley-dependent magnetic moments. Our work establishes rhombohedral graphene as a multi-knob platform for different isospin-polarized superconductivities, which enables programmable superconducting networks with possible Majorana modes along domain walls.

AI.tldr: 本文在菱方六层石墨烯(R6G)中发现了磁场诱导的新型超导态(SCH)，与已有的手性超导(CSC)共存，实现了全部四种自旋-谷同位旋味道的可切换超导，构成了可编程的手性超导四重奏体系。
AI.motivation: 菱方石墨烯中的超导来源于自旋-谷极化的四分之一金属(QM)母态，具有轨道时间反演对称性破缺特征。探索和控制全部自旋-谷同位旋味道的超导态对于实现新型超导和拓扑器件至关重要，但此前尚未被研究。
AI.method: 对菱方六层石墨烯(R6G)进行输运测量，施加面外磁场、调控载流子浓度和栅极位移场，并通过量子振荡和反常霍尔测量分析母态性质。
AI.result: 1) 发现磁场诱导的新超导态SCH(0.8-1.6 T)，可由磁场、载流子浓度和位移场开关调控；2) SCH源于场诱导的四分之一金属(QM')母相，其轨道磁化与零场QM相反；3) 在全部(n, D, H⊥)参数空间中实现了四种自旋-谷同位旋味道的超导，建立了可切换的手性超导四重奏。
AI.conclusion: 菱方石墨烯可作为多旋钮平台实现不同同位旋极化的超导态，有望构建可编程超导网络，在畴壁上实现可能的马约拉纳模。

title: Hidden Entropy Production at Mechanical Stall: Exact Reconstruction in a Reciprocal Brownian Motor
summary: We show that in a reciprocal Brownian motor the entropy production hidden behind a mechanically stalled coordinate can be reconstructed exactly from measurements of that coordinate alone. We introduce a minimal, analytically solvable Langevin motor in which an observed translational coordinate is coupled reciprocally to a hidden internal rotor: a single periodic potential $V(x-\ellθ)$ generates both the force on the observed coordinate and the reaction torque on the hidden one, so that $τ_{\rm int}=-\ell F_x$ holds identically. Force--torque reciprocity together with translational symmetry produces a local current identity that closes the hidden thermodynamic bookkeeping. From it we prove that the Harada--Sasa heat measured through the observed coordinate equals the positive current-square dissipation of that coordinate, with the information-flow correction vanishing identically. eciprocal class. ries in that it requires no separation of time scales.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在具有力-力矩互易性的布朗马达中，即使隐藏坐标被机械锁定，仅通过观测平移坐标的测量就能精确重构隐藏的熵产生。通过一个最小解析朗之万马达模型，作者建立了互易耦合下的局域流恒等式，并证明Harada-Sasa热测量值等于观测坐标的正流平方耗散，信息流修正项恒为零。
AI.motivation: 解决互易布朗马达中隐藏自由度（如内部转子）对熵产生贡献的不可观测性问题，旨在证明仅通过观测坐标即可完整重构隐藏的热力学记账，无需时间尺度分离假设。
AI.method: 提出一个最小解析可解的朗之万马达模型：观测平移坐标与隐藏内部转子通过单个周期势V(x-ℓθ)互易耦合（力-力矩互易关系τ_int=-ℓF_x恒成立）。利用力-力矩互易性和平移对称性推导局域流恒等式，进而证明隐藏热力学记账可由观测坐标完整闭合。
AI.result: 1) 建立了局域流恒等式，使得隐藏自由度的热力学信息可完全由观测坐标重构。2) 证明了Harada-Sasa关系测量的热等于观测坐标的正流平方耗散。3) 发现信息流修正项在此类互易系统中恒为零。
AI.conclusion: 在互易布朗马达这一重要类别中，隐藏自由度的熵产生可以通过观测坐标的测量精确重构，且无需时间尺度分离假设。这为实验上仅通过可观测坐标研究非平衡热力学提供了理论依据。

title: Interfacial Noncollinear Filtering of Spin Hall Currents
summary: Spin Hall currents generated in nonmagnetic materials are conventionally regarded as bulk responses whose polarization is fixed by crystal symmetry. This view has motivated the search for intrinsically low-symmetry spin sources when unconventional spin polarizations are required. Here we point out that, in realistic heterostructures, the device-relevant quantity is not the fully symmetry-averaged bulk spin Hall current, but the emitted spin current transmitted across the interface. We therefore establish emitted spin currents as bulk-interface hybrid responses and propose interfacial noncollinear filtering as a mechanism to bypass the bulk-symmetry constraint. A low-symmetry interfacial spin-orbit field, generally noncollinear with the momentum-resolved spin polarization of the incident spin Hall current, imposes spin-dependent transmission and converts hidden momentum-resolved spin-polarization components into an observable unconventional emitted spin current. Using both a rotationally symmetric minimal model and a realistic high-symmetry Dirac-semimetal model, we show that conventional spin Hall sources can emit sizable out-of-plane spin currents when their hidden bulk spin Hall textures are selectively transmitted by the interfacial spin-orbit field. Our results reveal that spin-current polarization emerges from the cooperative action of bulk and interfacial responses, providing a strategy for reprogramming spin-current polarization in high-efficiency, CMOS-compatible spin Hall materials without relying on intrinsically low-symmetry bulk crystals or external symmetry-breaking schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在真实异质结构中，器件相关的自旋电流并非对称平均化的体自旋霍尔电流，而是穿过界面后发射的自旋电流。作者提出界面非共线滤波机制，通过低对称性界面自旋-轨道场对体自旋霍尔电流进行选择性传输，从而产生非常规自旋电流极化，无需依赖低对称性体晶体或外部对称性破缺。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为自旋霍尔电流的极化由晶体对称性固定，这限制了自旋源材料的选取。作者旨在揭示实际器件中界面效应对自旋电流极化的关键作用，突破体对称性约束，为在传统高对称性材料中实现非常规自旋极化提供新思路。
AI.method: 建立体-界面混合响应理论，提出界面非共线滤波机制。通过旋转对称最小模型和高对称Dirac半金属模型进行理论验证，展示隐藏的自旋霍尔纹理如何在界面自旋-轨道场作用下选择性传输，产生可观的面外自旋电流。
AI.result: 传统自旋霍尔源可以在界面自旋-轨道场的选择性传输下发射出可观的面外自旋电流。自旋电流极化是体响应和界面响应的协同作用结果。
AI.conclusion: 自旋电流极化由体与界面响应的协同作用决定，这提供了一种无需依赖低对称性体晶体或外部对称性破缺方案，即可在高效、CMOS兼容的自旋霍尔材料中重新编程自旋电流极化的策略。

title: Skyrmion Phase Control by Magnetic Dipole-Dipole Interaction and Electric Field in Centrosymmetric Materials
summary: Establishing precise control over the helicity and spatial configuration of magnetic skyrmions will be essential to realize their promise in classical, analog and quantum computation applications. In this work, we explore the role of magnetic dipole-dipole interactions, external electric fields, and magnetic fields in controlling these parameters within a triangular lattice centrosymmetric skyrmion host. We demonstrate that dipole-dipole interactions strongly favor Bloch helicity. Notably, a zero magnetic field skyrmion phase appears upon raising the dipole-dipole coupling strength, with substantial potential for cost-effective quantum device applications. We also report the emergence of a meron/antimeron lattice phase, in the absence of any Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction. In contrast, applied electric fields stabilize high density Néel skyrmion crystals. The interplay between dipole-dipole interactions and external electric fields creates a continuous transition between the two skyrmion types, rather than an abrupt switch. Applied electric fields can therefore be used as a continuous tuning mechanism for skyrmion helicity, and hence a control handle for tuning two-level systems in skyrmion qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在三角晶格中心对称斯格明子材料中，通过磁偶极相互作用、电场和磁场来控制斯格明子的手性和空间构型。发现偶极相互作用偏好布洛赫手性，可产生零磁场斯格明子相，并出现无DMI的meron/反meron晶格相；电场则稳定高密度Néel斯格明子，并实现两种手性之间的连续调控，为斯格明子量子比特应用提供控制手段。
AI.motivation: 实现对磁斯格明子手性和空间构型的精确控制，以推动其在经典、模拟及量子计算中的应用。
AI.method: 在三角晶格中心对称斯格明子体系中，理论探索磁偶极-偶极相互作用、外电场和外磁场对手性及构型的调控作用。
AI.result: (1) 偶极相互作用强烈偏好布洛赫手性；(2) 提高偶极耦合强度可产生零磁场斯格明子相；(3) 在无DMI条件下出现meron/反meron晶格相；(4) 电场稳定高密度Néel斯格明子晶格；(5) 偶极与电场共同作用实现两种手性间的连续过渡。
AI.conclusion: 偶极相互作用与电场的协同可实现斯格明子手性的连续调控，为斯格明子量子比特中二能级系统的调谐提供控制手段。

title: High temperature ferromagnetism in epitaxial monolayers of Co-doped Fe5GeTe2
summary: Magnetic van der Waals materials have mainly been investigated in their bulk form or as few-layers flakes. Due to the challenges in producing atomically thin films, only a few have been isolated as monolayers, which typically exhibit long-range magnetic order below 150 K. In this work, we use molecular beam epitaxy to synthesize Co-doped Fe5GeTe2, achieving precise control over both thickness and composition. We demonstrate ferromagnetism well above room temperature in multilayer samples and present clear evidence of ferromagnetic ordering in monolayers up to $\sim$200 K. The changes in Curie temperature and magnetic anisotropy with composition exhibit similar trends in both monolayers and thicker films, indicating that the magnetic properties are primarily governed by intralayer magnetic interactions. Through element-specific X-ray magnetic circular dichroism and density functional theory, we identify the substitution site of Co dopants and reveal the mechanism behind the Curie temperature enhancement induced by Co doping. Our findings suggest that, despite their weak magnetic moment, Co dopants strengthen the magnetic moments on neighboring Fe atoms and enhance the intralayer ferromagnetic exchange interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分子束外延成功合成了Co掺杂的Fe5GeTe2，实现了厚度和成分的精确控制。在多层样品中观察到室温以上的铁磁性，并在单层中证明铁磁有序最高可达~200 K。Curie温度和磁各向异性的变化趋势在不同厚度样品中相似，表明磁性质主要由层内磁相互作用决定。通过元素特异性X射线磁圆二色性和密度泛函理论，确定了Co掺杂位点并揭示了居里温度增强机制：Co掺杂虽本身磁矩弱，但增强了邻近Fe原子的磁矩和层内铁磁交换作用。
AI.motivation: 磁性范德华材料大多只在块体或少数层薄片中被研究，由于制备原子级薄膜的挑战，只有少数材料被剥离为单层且通常居里温度低于150 K。本工作旨在通过分子束外延合成Co掺杂Fe5GeTe2，实现室温以上铁磁性的多层及单层薄膜，并探究其磁性调控机制。
AI.method: 采用分子束外延（MBE）精确控制薄膜厚度和成分；利用元素特异性X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）和密度泛函理论（DFT）确定Co掺杂位点并分析磁性增强机制。
AI.result: 多层样品展示室温以上铁磁性，单层样品铁磁有序最高可达~200 K；Curie温度和磁各向异性在单层和厚膜中随成分变化趋势一致；Co掺杂增强邻近Fe原子磁矩及层内铁磁交换相互作用。
AI.conclusion: Co掺杂通过增强邻近Fe原子的磁矩和层内铁磁交换作用来提升居里温度，为二维磁性材料的室温应用提供了可行途径。

title: From Valley Filtering to Superconducting Diode Effect in Spin-Orbit Coupled Graphene Junctions
summary: We study the transport properties of proximitized graphene, which can acquire a spin-orbit coupling by the proximity effect with a substrate. We focus on the ballistic and zero temperature limits, making use of a tight-binding procedure based on the KWANT Python package. We first find key results on valley-filtering properties and asymmetric edge transport in spin-orbit coupled graphene single junctions, and then move to the analysis of the superconducting transport in a graphene Josephson junction, in the short junction limit. We study the relative contribution of edge modes for different edge terminations and some degree of edge disorder, and also analyze the magnetic interference pattern that arises when threading the junction with a perpendicular magnetic field. We find residual supercurrent at high magnetic fluxes, due to the localized nature of transport in the junction, and a strong non-reciprocal transport that leads to a significant Josephson diode effect.

AI.tldr: 本文通过紧束缚模型（KWANT）研究近邻化石墨烯在弹道输运和零温极限下的输运特性，包括自旋-轨道耦合导致的谷滤波、非对称边缘输运，以及在短约瑟夫森结中的超导输运、边缘模贡献、磁场干涉图样、剩余超流和约瑟夫森二极管效应。
AI.motivation: 探索近邻化石墨烯中自旋-轨道耦合对其输运性质的影响，特别是谷滤波、边缘输运以及超导约瑟夫森结中的新奇物理现象。
AI.method: 采用基于KWANT Python包的紧束缚方法，在弹道输运和零温极限下进行数值模拟。分别研究单结中的谷滤波和边缘输运，以及短结极限下石墨烯约瑟夫森结的超导输运，分析不同边缘终止、边缘无序及垂直磁场下的干涉图案。
AI.result: 发现了谷滤波特性和不对称边缘输运；在高磁通下存在由局域输运导致的剩余超流；观察到显著的非互易输运，产生明显的约瑟夫森二极管效应。
AI.conclusion: 近邻化石墨烯中的自旋-轨道耦合能诱导丰富的输运现象，包括谷滤波、非对称边缘输运和约瑟夫森二极管效应，对石墨烯基超导电子器件有重要启示。

title: Quantum Density of States and Integer Partitions: A Semiclassical Approach
summary: In this review we discuss semi-classical methods that are traditionally used to describe many-body systems in physics, but may also be used to describe partitions of integers in analytic number theory. Specifically, we explore the connection between the methods of statistical mechanics and number partitions. Though the two fields appear very different, their fundamental issues bear a close resemblance. In the former case it is the distribution of a given amount of energy among the particles in an ensemble at a given temperature with well defined properties, while in the latter case it is the way an integer is partitioned into other integers, with or without restrictions. We begin with a discussion of the single-particle quantum density of states, also called the level density, in which we illustrate the connection between the density of states and the classical periodic orbits through the semiclassical trace formula. This is then extended to many particle systems. We show that the asymptotic number partition is reproduced by the average (smooth) part of the level density at discrete integer values of the argument. In the especially interesting case of distinct square partitions, pronounced oscillations are well reproduced by the periodic orbit theory in terms of a few orbits characterised by Pythagorean number triples. We speculate on the connection to Fermat's theorem as to why such regular oscillations (though vanishing asymptotically) exist only in this special case. Finally, we discuss some new results for integer partitions of primes, both unrestricted and distinct.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了半经典方法在统计力学与解析数论中整数分拆问题之间的深刻联系。通过能级密度与周期轨道理论，展示了整数分拆的渐近行为如何从多粒子系统的平滑能级密度中再现，并特别讨论了勾股数三元组在区分平方分拆振荡中的作用，以及素数分拆的新结果。
AI.motivation: 尽管统计力学（描述能量在粒子间的分布）与数论（描述整数的分拆方式）看似毫无关联，但作者揭示了二者在基本问题结构上的高度相似性，旨在通过半经典方法架起两大学科之间的桥梁。
AI.method: 采用半经典迹公式（semiclassical trace formula），从单粒子量子态密度（能级密度）出发，建立其与经典周期轨道的联系，进而推广到多粒子系统。通过将整数分拆的渐近行为与离散整数参数处的平滑能级密度进行对比，并利用周期轨道理论再现区分平方分拆中的显著振荡。
AI.result: 证明了整数分拆的渐近公式可由多粒子系统能级密度的平滑部分在离散整数值处重现；在区分平方分拆这一特殊情形中，少数几条由勾股数三元组刻画的周期轨道即可精确再现显著的振荡模式。
AI.conclusion: 半经典方法为理解整数分拆提供了全新的物理视角，区分平方分拆中振荡的存在（尽管渐近消失）与费马大定理存在深层联系；此外，作者还给出了素数分拆（无限制与有区别两类情形）的新结果。

title: Layer-selective chirality switch in bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers
summary: We predict that intercalating bilayer graphene with nonmagnetic WSSe or magnetic MnSSe Janus monolayers induces a layer-selective switch of the in-plane Rashba spin texture, resulting in opposite spin current directions in the top and bottom graphene layers. First-principles calculations reveal that both Janus monolayers decouple the two graphene layers while simultaneously inducing opposite signs of the proximity-induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling in each. Tight-binding modeling of the proximitized layers, combined with Rashba-Edelstein charge-to-spin conversion calculations, confirms that the spin current direction can be independently controlled by gating the top or bottom graphene layer. Bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers thus represents a promising platform for gate-tunable, layer-selective spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文预言在双层石墨烯中插入非磁性WSSe或磁性MnSSe Janus单层，可诱导层选择性的面内Rashba自旋纹理翻转，从而在上下石墨烯层中产生相反的自旋电流方向。第一性原理计算和紧束缚模型证实，通过门电压可独立控制每层的自旋电流方向，为可门控的层选择性自旋电子器件提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 实现层选择性的自旋电流控制，为开发门可调谐的层选择性自旋电子器件提供新机制。
AI.method: 第一性原理计算（First-principles calculations）结合紧束缚模型（Tight-binding modeling）以及Rashba-Edelstein电荷-自旋转换计算。
AI.result: Janus单层可解耦双层石墨烯，并在上下层中诱导相反符号的近邻Rashba自旋-轨道耦合，导致相反的自旋电流方向；通过门电压可独立控制每层的自旋电流。
AI.conclusion: Janus单层插层的双层石墨烯是门可调、层选择性自旋电子器件的有前景平台。

title: Instabilities of Fermi Liquids with Arbitrary Forward Scattering: Exact Approach
summary: In this work, we consider $N$-fold degenerate $D$-dimensional electron gas with spherical Fermi surface and arbitrary forward-scattering density-density interaction transferring small momentum compared to the Fermi momentum $k_{\mathrm{F}}$. The dimensional reduction that is mathematically equivalent to the Haldane patch construction and similar multidimensional bosonization techniques, provides a natural map of two-point $D$-dimensional correlation functions (fermion Green function, susceptibilities etc.) onto effective one-dimensional (1D) correlators with the same diagrammatic structure, which can be evaluated exactly within a 1D bosonizable (Gaussian) theory. We then apply this formalism to evaluate the fermion Green function, pair and charge/flavor susceptibilities, as well as the composite correlation functions for the case of a finite-range interaction, where the interaction range $R_{\mathrm{s}} \gg 1/k_{\mathrm{F}}$ is large compared to the Fermi wavelength. First, we find that the single-particle spectral function remains Fermi-liquid-like which is fully consistent with the previous research. In contrast to the single-particle sector, the many-body channels are efficiently dressed by finite-range interactions, and this dressing is fully equivalent to the one-loop renormalization group (RG), which is also in line with previous multidimensional bosonization results. Within the forward-scattering model, stable long-range order is not possible, and relevant susceptibilities demonstrate singular power-law scaling with temperature $T$ at $T \to 0$. The rest of the abstract is in the PDF.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有球形费米面和任意前向散射密度-密度相互作用的N重简并D维电子气。通过维度约化方法（等价于Haldane贴片构造和多维玻色化技术），将D维两点关联函数映射到有效一维关联函数，并在有限程相互作用下计算了费米子格林函数、配对/电荷/味磁化率等。结果发现单粒子谱保持费米液体行为，而多体通道被有限程相互作用有效重整化，等价于单圈RG结果。在前向散射模型中不存在稳定长程序，相关磁化率在T→0时呈现幂律发散。
AI.motivation: 动机是发展一种处理具有前向散射相互作用的简并电子气的理论框架，利用维度约化映射将高维费米子问题转化为可精确求解的一维玻色化问题，以研究有限程相互作用对单粒子和多体通道的非微扰效应。
AI.method: 采用维度约化方法（等效于Haldane贴片构造和多维玻色化），将D维费米子两点关联函数映射到有效一维关联函数，后者可用一维高斯（玻色化）理论精确求解。针对有限程相互作用（R_s >> 1/k_F）的情况，计算了单粒子格林函数、配对磁化率、电荷/味磁化率以及复合关联函数。
AI.result: (1) 单粒子谱函数保持费米液体行为，与先前研究一致；(2) 多体通道被有限程相互作用有效重整化，等价于单圈RG结果；(3) 在前向散射模型中，不存在稳定长程序；(4) 相关磁化率在T→0时呈现奇异幂律标度行为。
AI.conclusion: 前向散射模型下单粒子保持费米液体特征，但多体通道受有限程相互作用显著影响（等价于单圈RG），且长程序被抑制，只能出现幂律奇异性。

title: Deep-learning Hamiltonian reveals twist-tunable flat bands and nonlinear photocurrents in SrTiO3 moire bilayers
summary: The extension of moire physics to complex oxides offers new ways to manipulate electronic states, but the large oxide moire supercells make systematic first-principles calculations demanding. Here, we combine density functional theory with the E(3)-equivariant deep-learning Hamiltonian framework DeepH-E3 to investigate the twist-angle-dependent electronic structure and optical responses of twisted bilayer SrTiO3. The model is trained on untwisted bilayers with different interlayer-sliding configurations and then applied to commensurate twisted bilayers with twist angles from 8.80 degrees to 53.13 degrees. Compared with the untwisted bilayer, decreasing twist angle systematically flattens the valence bands and leads to nearly dispersionless bands at the smallest angles studied. Based on the predicted Hamiltonians, we evaluate the dielectric response, second-harmonic generation (SHG), shift current, and spin Hall conductivity. The dielectric response and spin Hall conductivity remain close to those of the untwisted bilayer, whereas the nonlinear optical responses are more strongly affected by twisting. SHG is strongly enhanced relative to the weak untwisted response, and the shift current shows a clear twist-angle dependence within the response-calculation range (53.13 degrees-22.62 degrees). These results show that twist engineering can control electronic and optoelectronic responses in oxide moire systems.

AI.tldr: 本文结合密度泛函理论与E(3)等变深度学习哈密顿框架DeepH-E3，研究扭转双层SrTiO3的电子结构和光学响应。模型在未扭转双层上训练，应用于不同扭转角度的体系，发现减小扭转角会使价带变平，非线性光学响应受扭转影响显著，SHG显著增强，为氧化物莫尔体系的扭转工程提供了新思路。
AI.motivation: 将莫尔物理扩展到复杂氧化物为调控电子态提供了新途径，但大型氧化物莫尔超胞使得系统的第一性原理计算成本过高，亟需高效的计算方法。
AI.method: 将密度泛函理论(DFT)与E(3)等变深度学习哈密顿框架DeepH-E3相结合，在未扭转双层（不同层间滑动构型）上训练模型，然后应用于不同扭转角（8.80°到53.13°）的扭转双层SrTiO3体系。
AI.result: 减小扭转角使价带系统性地变平，最小角度下近乎无色散；介电响应和自旋霍尔电导率接近未扭转体系；非线性光学响应（SHG和shift current）受扭转影响强烈，SHG显著增强。
AI.conclusion: 扭转工程可以有效调控氧化物莫尔体系中的电子和光电响应，为相关功能材料设计提供新策略。

title: Uncertainty relations for arbitrary currents in coherent transport
summary: We derive thermodynamic and kinetic uncertainty relations valid for arbitrary currents in coherent, strongly coupled, linear systems out of equilibrium. Exploiting properties of the transport statistics, in particular fluctuation theorems, we identify the relevant entropy production and activity that determine the cost of precision at the level of individual scattering events. The resulting bounds include higher-order fluctuations and remain valid far from equilibrium. We illustrate our results in normal and superconducting hybrid structures, and show that their predictiveness and validity range exceeds existing formulations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对相干、强耦合、线性非平衡系统中的任意电流，推导了热力学和动力学不确定关系，利用输运统计特性（特别是涨落定理）识别了决定单个散射事件精度代价的熵产生和活性，所得界限包含高阶涨落且在远离平衡态时仍有效，在正常和超导混合结构中验证了其预测能力和适用范围优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定关系在远离平衡态、强耦合或相干系统中的适用性有限，需要更通用的理论框架来刻画精度与耗散之间的基本权衡。
AI.method: 利用输运统计特性和涨落定理，识别熵产生和活性，推导包含高阶涨落的不确定关系，并在正常/超导混合结构中进行验证。
AI.result: 得到的界限包含高阶涨落，在远非平衡态仍有效，且预测能力和适用范围优于现有公式。
AI.conclusion: 建立了更普适的热力学和动力学不确定关系，拓展了非平衡统计物理中精度-耗散权衡理论的应用边界。

title: Correlation of maximum superconducting critical temperature with copper-oxygen energy distance and oxygen hole content in the Emery model
summary: Identifying microscopic parameters that optimize the maximum superconducting critical temperature $T_c^{\rm max}$ in the canonical model of the copper-oxygen plane of cuprates, the Emery model, remains challenging. Using cellular dynamical mean-field theory at finite temperature, we find that for a fixed charge gap size in the parent charge-transfer insulating state, $T_c^{\rm max}$ unexpectedly increases with increasing the copper-oxygen energy distance, as this favors the transfer of electrons from oxygen to copper orbitals. We show that these findings emerge naturally in the Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen scheme and capture observed trends in hole-doped cuprates. Overall, our study uncovers that $T_c^{\rm max}$ is optimized in the Emery model under three conditions: upon doping a charge-transfer insulator, close to the charge-transfer insulator to metal boundary, and deep into the charge-transfer regime. This finding indicates new paths for optimizing $T_c^{\rm max}$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过有限温度下的细胞动力学平均场理论，发现Emery模型中最大超导临界温度$T_c^{\rm max}$在满足三个条件时达到最优：掺杂电荷转移绝缘体、靠近电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界、以及深入电荷转移区域。其中，增大铜-氧能级差反而有利于提高$T_c^{\rm max}$，这一反直觉发现可由Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen方案解释，并与空穴掺杂铜氧化物实验趋势一致。
AI.motivation: 识别在铜氧化物规范模型（Emery模型）中优化最大超导临界温度$T_c^{\rm max}$的微观参数，解决长期以来如何最大化$T_c^{\rm max}$这一核心问题。
AI.method: 采用有限温度下的细胞动力学平均场理论（cellular dynamical mean-field theory）对Emery模型进行数值模拟分析。
AI.result: 固定母体电荷转移绝缘态的能隙大小时，增大铜-氧能级差反而使$T_c^{\rm max}$上升，原因在于促进了电子从氧向铜轨道的转移。$T_c^{\rm max}$在三个条件下最优：掺杂电荷转移绝缘体、靠近绝缘体-金属边界、深入电荷转移区。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现自然符合Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen方案，并捕捉到空穴掺杂铜氧化物的实验趋势，为优化$T_c^{\rm max}$指明了新路径。

title: Stabilization of Stone-Wales Defects in Metal-supported Graphene
summary: The characteristics of graphene-metal interfaces play a decisive role in their electronic, optoelectronic, and mechanical applications. Properties such as charge transfer across the interface become particularly significant in the presence of topological defects. The stability of Stone Wales (SW) defects in graphene is governed by the balance between three energy descriptors, the activation energy, formation energy, and restoration energy. By comparing the energy parameters obtained from first-principles density functional theory calculations, we show that SW defect formation is energetically more favorable on metal-supported graphene. Our calculations for SW defects in graphene/Cu(111) and graphene/Al(111) systems indicate only a little dependence of energy profile on the type of metal. The presence of the metal substrate leads to a $\sim$ 12\% increase in the formation energy and a $\sim$ 20\% reduction in the activation energy, which together favor the formation of Stone Wales defects. Although the restoration energy decreases by about $\sim$ 35\% in metal-supported graphene, it remains significantly higher to prevent self-healing. As a result, once formed, the Stone Wales defects are likely to remain stable, suggesting the possibility of terminal SW defect formation in metal-supported graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算发现，金属衬底（Cu/Al）有利于石墨烯中Stone Wales缺陷的形成——活化能降低约20%、形成能增加约12%，且缺陷一旦形成难以自愈，表明金属支撑石墨烯上可能产生稳定的终端SW缺陷。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯-金属界面的特性对其电子、光电子及机械应用至关重要，而拓扑缺陷（如Stone Wales缺陷）会显著影响界面电荷转移等性质。理解金属衬底如何影响SW缺陷的稳定性，对于调控石墨烯器件性能具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，比较石墨烯/Cu(111)和石墨烯/Al(111)体系中SW缺陷的活化能、形成能和恢复能三个能量参数，并与自由态石墨烯进行对比。
AI.result: 金属衬底使形成能增加约12%、活化能降低约20%、恢复能降低约35%；且能量参数对金属类型（Cu vs Al）依赖性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 金属衬底从能量角度促进了SW缺陷的形成，且恢复能虽降低但仍足够高，阻止自修复，因此金属支撑石墨烯上可能形成稳定的终端SW缺陷。

title: Robust q-negative Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient
summary: The multifractal detrended cross-correlation coefficient $ρ_q(n)$ is widely used to investigate scale-dependent interactions, but its application to negative fluctuation orders is affected by numerical instabilities, unbounded values, and interpretational difficulties. We propose a Signed Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient, $ρ_{\mathrm{SMFDCCA}}(n,q)$, an amplitude-conditioned correlation observable for multifractal detrended analysis, based on locally normalized detrended correlations and regularized fluctuation amplitudes. The proposed coefficient preserves the sign of local interactions, remains strictly bounded within $[-1,1]$ for both positive and negative values of $q$, and eliminates the corrective procedures required by previous approaches. Validation using independent fractional Gaussian noise confirms the absence of spurious cross-correlations and the numerical stability of the method. Applications demonstrate that the proposed observable resolves how cross-correlations evolve jointly with temporal scale and fluctuation amplitude, revealing scale- and amplitude-dependent correlation structures, including stronger synchronization during large fluctuations in stock-market indices and heterogeneous coupling patterns in temperature records.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种带符号的多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数 ρ_SMFDCCA(n,q)，解决了传统方法在负波动阶数下的数值不稳定、无界值及解释困难等问题，并验证了其在金融和气候数据中的应用效果。
AI.motivation: 传统多重分形去趋势交叉相关系数 ρ_q(n) 在负波动阶数下存在数值不稳定、值域无界及解释困难等局限，亟需一种更稳健、可解释性更强的交叉相关性度量方法。
AI.method: 提出 Signed Multifractal Detrended Cross-Correlation Coefficient (ρ_SMFDCCA)，基于局部归一化的去趋势相关性和正则化波动幅度，构建幅值条件化的相关可观测量，保持局部交互符号，严格限制在 [-1,1] 范围内。
AI.result: 通过独立分数高斯噪声验证了该方法无虚假交叉相关且数值稳定；实际应用显示其能揭示尺度与幅值依赖的相关结构，如股票指数大幅波动时的强同步性及气温记录中的异质耦合模式。
AI.conclusion: 新提出的系数有效克服了传统方法的缺陷，为分析跨尺度、跨幅值的交叉相关结构提供了一个稳健且可解释的工具。

title: Classical Reversible Computation by Quantum Coherence
summary: Rising energy demand from data-centre and AI applications has renewed interest in reversible computation, where logic need not dissipate heat at every step if information is uncomputed. Implementations have so far been classical: adiabatic CMOS reduces dissipation by slowing charge motion but is still limited by the threshold physics of transistors. Here we propose classical reversible logic implemented by coherent spin dynamics in a spin quantum-dot array, with inputs and outputs in classical basis states and no algorithmic use of superposition. The same spin stores, transports, and computes, with unitary rotation replacing irreversible switching. The universal building block is an iToffoli gate driven by DC voltage pulses and anisotropic exchange in Ge/Si hole spins. Simulations with experimental parameters reproduce the Toffoli truth table and yield a testable error landscape. Because shuttling transports the bit without measurement, logic and data movement remain reversible until readout. Millivolt pulses on femtofarad gates yield a gate energy below the 4~K Landauer scale, about five (eight) orders of magnitude below a room-temperature CMOS Toffoli with (without) 4 K cooling overhead. The same semiconductor hardware is therefore dual-use, supporting quantum algorithms when superposition is used and classical reversible logic otherwise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于自旋量子点阵列的经典可逆逻辑实现方案，利用相干自旋动力学和iToffoli门，无需叠加态即可实现超低能耗计算，能耗比室温CMOS低5-8个数量级，且同一硬件可兼用量子计算。
AI.motivation: 数据中心和AI应用的能耗激增，使可逆计算重新成为关注焦点。现有绝热CMOS虽降低耗散但受晶体管阈值物理限制，亟需新的低能耗计算范式。
AI.method: 采用自旋量子点阵列中的相干自旋动力学实现经典可逆逻辑，以自旋存储、传输和计算，用幺正旋转替代不可逆开关。核心构建模块为iToffoli门，通过直流电压脉冲和Ge/Si空穴自旋的各向异性交换作用驱动。
AI.result: 模拟验证了Toffoli真值表并给出可测试误差图。毫伏级脉冲在飞法栅极上实现门能耗低于4K Landauer标度，比室温CMOS Toffoli低约5个数量级（含4K冷却开销）或8个数量级（不含）。
AI.conclusion: 同一半导体硬件可双用途使用：利用叠加态时支持量子算法，否则执行经典可逆逻辑，为未来低能耗计算提供了可行路径。

title: Charge-transfer gap size and oxygen hole content as two mechanisms controlling $T_c$ in the Emery model
summary: Investigating the drivers of superconducting critical temperature trends in cuprates is crucial for uncovering the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity. Here we study this problem in the canonical model of the copper-oxygen plane, the Emery model, with cellular dynamical mean-field theory. Using the Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen diagram as a guiding framework, we systematically quantify how the maximum superconducting critical temperature $T_c^{\rm max}$ depends on the copper-oxygen energy distance and on the local repulsion on the copper orbital. Unexpectedly, $T_c^{\rm max}$ is optimized not only near the charge-transfer insulator to metal boundary, consistent with previous findings, but also deep in the charge-transfer regime, revealing an unexplored mechanism. Then we link model parameters to physical observables, identifying the charge-transfer gap size and the oxygen hole content as two mechanisms controlling $T_c^{\rm max}$. $T_c^{\rm max}$ increases monotonically as the oxygen hole content increases and the charge gap size decreases. The oxygen hole content is the dominant variable in varying $T_c^{\rm max}$. Our work provides predictions for proposed realizations of the Emery model with ultracold atoms and a theoretical framework for understanding key experimental trends in hole-doped cuprates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Emery模型和动力学平均场理论，系统研究了铜氧化物超导中最大临界温度Tc_max的驱动因素，发现Tc_max不仅在电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界附近最优，而且在电荷转移区深处也存在优化机制，并揭示了氧空穴含量是调控Tc_max的主导变量。
AI.motivation: 探究铜氧化物超导临界温度趋势的驱动因素，对于揭示高温超导机制至关重要。
AI.method: 采用铜氧平面的规范模型——Emery模型，结合细胞动力学平均场理论（CDMFT），并以Zaanen-Sawatzky-Allen图作为指导框架进行系统量化分析。
AI.result: Tc_max不仅在电荷转移绝缘体-金属边界附近最优，还在电荷转移区深处存在优化；Tc_max随氧空穴含量增加和电荷隙减小而单调增加，其中氧空穴含量是主导变量。
AI.conclusion: 为超冷原子实现Emery模型提供了预测，并为理解空穴掺杂铜氧化物的关键实验趋势提供了理论框架。

title: Multiscale modelling of diffusion and retention of hydrogen in multi-occupancy traps in irradiated bcc metals
summary: We use molecular dynamics simulations to directly compute the effective diffusivity of hydrogen gas atoms in homogeneous distributions of monovacancies in tungsten and vanadium, and voids in tungsten. Rather than fitting the results to an Arrhenius law, we compare to an analytic approximation for the effective diffusivity recently derived for multi-occupancy traps [Kaur et al (2025), Phys. Rev. Mater. 9:125404]. We find good agreement between full atomistic simulation and our theory, validating the analytic model for diffusivity for materials containing nanoscale defects characteristic of radiation damage. There are no parameters fitted, only physically motivated quantities that can be computed with static density functional or atomistic potential calculations. In this study we prove rapid convergence of hydrogen trap occupation to the steady state using lattice kinetic Monte Carlo, the spontaneous emergence of voids in tungsten using atomistic simulation with empirical potentials, and molecular hydrogen formation in voids using molecular dynamics. We conclude with a prediction for diffusion and retention of hydrogen in voids in tungsten starting from first principles. This work shows that not only is the analytic form for diffusivity and retention in multi-occupancy traps a practical scheme for making predictive simulations of hydrogen isotope diffusion and retention in irradiated microstructures, derived and parameterized from first principles, it is superior to existing single-occupancy trap formalisms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子动力学模拟直接计算氢原子在钨和钒中的单空位以及钨中空穴的有效扩散率，并与最近提出的多占据陷阱解析扩散率近似模型进行对比，验证了该模型的准确性。该模型无需拟合参数，仅依赖静态密度泛函或原子势计算。研究还证明氢陷阱占据快速收敛到稳态、空穴在钨中自发形成以及分子氢在空穴中形成。最终基于第一性原理预测了氢在钨空穴中的扩散和滞留行为，表明多占据陷阱形式优于现有的单占据陷阱形式。
AI.motivation: 现有单占据陷阱模型不足以准确描述氢同位素在辐照损伤材料中的扩散和滞留行为，亟需一个基于第一性原理、无需拟合参数的多占据陷阱解析模型来提升预测能力。
AI.method: 使用分子动力学直接计算有效扩散率；采用晶格动力学蒙特卡洛证明陷阱占据快速收敛到稳态；利用经验势的原子模拟证明空穴自发形成；通过分子动力学证明空穴中分子氢的形成。所有结果与多占据陷阱解析近似模型进行对比验证。
AI.result: 全原子模拟与多占据陷阱解析模型高度一致，验证了该模型的准确性；证明了氢陷阱占据快速收敛到稳态、空穴自发形成以及分子氢在空穴中生成等现象。
AI.conclusion: 多占据陷阱解析模型不仅是一个实用的、基于第一性原理的预测方案，而且在描述氢同位素在辐照微结构中的扩散和滞留方面优于现有的单占据陷阱形式。

title: Static vacancies as parametrized conformal defects in the critical $J_1$--$J_2$ transverse-field Ising chain
summary: We revisit the problem of two static nonmagnetic vacancies in the transverse-field Ising chain with first- and second-neighbor couplings $J_1$ and $J_2$, now on the critical line, using density-matrix renormalization-group (DMRG) calculations in open chains of up to $N=300$ sites. In contrast to the gapped regime studied previously, where the vacancy-vacancy interaction decays exponentially, along the entire quantum critical line the interaction becomes algebraic, $|Δ_b(r)|\sim r^{-α}$, with $α$ close to the universal Casimir value of unity and a weak but systematic dependence on the second-neighbor coupling, $α_\infty \simeq 1.070 + 0.091\, J_2/J_1)$ across $J_2/J_1\in[0.1,1.0]$. The transmission ratio of the spin correlator across a vacancy approaches a $J_2$-dependent plateau $T_\infty(J_2)$ that grows from $0.11$ to $0.33$ over the same range, and the Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy is small and approximately constant, $\log g_\infty \approx -0.073$, well above the Ising fixed-BC value $-\ln\sqrt{2}$ and close to the free-boundary value. The three observables vary smoothly and monotonically with $J_2$, consistent with a one-parameter family of partially transmissive conformal defects controlled by $J_2$. Throughout, the critical line is located using the bulk spin-correlator exponent $η=1/4$, the order-parameter exponent of the Ising universality class, which provides a robust criterion in this open geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DMRG计算，重新研究了在临界线上具有第一和第二近邻耦合的横场Ising链中两个静态非磁性空位的问题，发现空位间相互作用沿量子临界线呈代数衰减，衰减指数α接近通用Casimir值1，并随第二近邻耦合强度呈弱线性依赖。自旋关联函数通过空位的传输比随J₂增大而增大，边界熵接近自由边界值，三者共同构成一个由J₂控制的单参数共形缺陷族。
AI.motivation: 该工作的动机是重新审视存在两个静态非磁性空位时，横场Ising链在临界线上的行为，重点关注空位-空位相互作用的性质，以填补先前研究仅关注带隙区域而忽略了临界线行为的空白。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）方法，在最多N=300个格点的开放链中进行大规模数值计算，通过调节第二近邻耦合J₂来系统研究临界线上空位相互作用的代数衰减规律、自旋关联传输比和边界熵等物理量。
AI.result: 空位间相互作用沿量子临界线呈代数衰减，指数α≈1.070+0.091·(J₂/J₁)，接近通用Casimir值1；传输比T∞从0.11增长到0.33；边界熵log g∞≈-0.073，接近自由边界值；所有三个观测量随J₂单调连续变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了临界线上空位相互作用从指数衰减到代数衰减的转变，并建立了由J₂参数化的单参数共形缺陷族，为理解量子临界系统中的缺陷效应提供了新的见解。

title: Local spin magnetization in itinerant non-collinear magnets: The local spin Berry curvature
summary: Conventionally, the local spin magnetization in itinerant magnets is determined from the equilibrium local spin density. Here, we propose a thermodynamic approach in which the local spin magnetization is defined from the response of the system to an infinitesimal external magnetic field. The predictions of the two theories are identical for collinear magnets, but differ qualitatively and quantitatively for non-collinear magnets. In the present thermodynamic approach, the spin coherences determine an alternative distribution of local spin magnetization due to the field-induced deformation of the energy eigenstates. This effect is captured by a Berry-curvature-like contribution reminiscent of orbital magnetization and has several distinct observable consequences. We explore the differences between the conventional and thermodynamic approaches in several test cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于热力学响应的局域自旋磁化定义方法，通过系统对外部磁场的响应而非平衡自旋密度来定义磁化强度。该方法在共线磁体中与常规理论一致，但在非共线磁体中存在质和量的差异，并通过类似Berry曲率的贡献描述了自旋相干性导致的场致能态变形效应。
AI.motivation: 传统的局域自旋磁化定义依赖于平衡局域自旋密度，但作者认为在非共线磁体中，这种方法可能无法完整捕捉自旋相干性带来的物理效应，因此需要一种基于热力学响应的新定义方法。

title: Eclipsing Kitaev: off-diagonal exchange governs the correlated high-field phases of $β$-Li$_2$IrO$_3$
summary: We report a high-field thermodynamic study of the hyperhoneycomb Kitaev material $β$-Li$_2$IrO$_3$, using magnetotropic susceptibility to resolve its low-temperature field-angle phase diagram across the principal crystallographic planes in magnetic fields up to $60$ T. Rather than evolving directly from the low-field incommensurate state into a polarized regime, the system exhibits a strongly direction-dependent sequence of correlated phases. Most notably, for fields in the $ac$-plane, we identify an additional high-field phase that is absent in the other principal planes and exists only within a restricted region of field-angle space. This phase structure is naturally explained by the competition between magnetic field and bond-directional exchange interactions. Using a symmetry-based description supported by microscopic calculations within the $J$-$K$-$Γ$ model, we show that off-diagonal $Γ$ exchange couples the ferromagnetic and staggered magnetic orders and thereby stabilizes the observed correlated high-field phases. The measured angular dependence of the critical fields is quantitatively captured by this theory, identifying $Γ$ exchange as the key interaction controlling the high-field response. These results clarify why the promise of a field-induced spin liquid -- the notion that suppressing magnetic order might reveal the underlying Kitaev physics -- remains unfulfilled in candidate materials: even when the Kitaev interaction is large, off-diagonal exchange stabilizes symmetry-constrained correlated phases that instead preempt the polarized state.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高场热力学研究，揭示了β-Li₂IrO₃在高达60 T磁场下的场角相图，发现了一个仅存在于ac平面的高场相，并证明Γ交换作用是控制高场响应的关键因素，解释了为何场致自旋液体的承诺在候选材料中未能实现。
AI.motivation: 探究Kitaev材料β-Li₂IrO₃在高磁场下的相变行为，理解为何场致自旋液体（通过抑制磁序揭示Kitaev物理）的预言在候选材料中未能实现。
AI.method: 利用磁化率张量测量技术，在高达60 T的磁场下，解析β-Li₂IrO₃在主要晶面内的低温场角相图，并结合J-K-Γ模型进行对称性分析和微观计算。
AI.result: 发现了一个仅在ac平面内存在的额外高场相；揭示Γ交换耦合了铁磁序和交错磁序，从而稳定了高场关联相；理论定量捕捉了临界场的角度依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 即使Kitaev相互作用很大，非对角Γ交换相互作用会稳定受对称性约束的关联相，从而抢先于极化态，这正是场致自旋液体在候选材料中未能实现的原因。

title: Inverse heterodyne effect in bimodal Kelvin probe force microscopy
comment: 59 pages, 7 figures, 57 references. A supplementary information file is provided
summary: Heterodyne Kelvin probe force microscopy (He-KPFM) enables high-sensitivity electrostatic measurements by converting a bias-modulated interaction into a resonant response at a higher cantilever eigenmode. While the "direct" heterodyne actuation of the second eigenmode is well established, the dynamical back-action of this heterodyne-driven motion on the fundamental eigenmode has remained largely unexplored, particularly in open-loop operation where the second mode is excited to a finite amplitude. Here, we demonstrate an inverse heterodyne effect: a force component generated by heterodyne frequency conversion acts back on the first eigenmode and produces measurable inter-mode energy exchange. The analysis combines a bimodal virial and power-balance framework with a non-truncated description of the tip-surface capacitance-gradient dynamics developed and validated in a companion manuscript submitted concurrently to the same journal. On this basis, we derive closed-form expressions linking inverse heterodyne coupling to the experimentally accessible observables of non-contact AFM open-loop amplitude-modulated He-KPFM. The theory predicts that inverse heterodyne coupling appears predominantly in the dissipation channel, with a sharply resonant dependence on the demodulation frequency near the second-eigenmode resonance, while its conservative contribution to the frequency shift remains comparatively weaker under typical conditions. Ultrahigh-vacuum experiments validate these predictions and isolate the inverse heterodyne signature through frequency- and voltage-dependent measurements. Beyond KPFM, this work connects heterodyne force microscopy to a broader class of driven multimode systems in which nonlinear coupling and frequency conversion produce inter-mode energy transfer, back-action, and dissipation-based observables.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了异质外差开尔文探针力显微镜（He-KPFM）中存在一种“逆异质外差效应”，即第二本征模的驱动运动会通过力分量反馈作用于第一本征模，产生可测量的模间能量交换。该效应主要在耗散通道中表现显著，对频率偏移的保守贡献较弱，并在超高真空实验中通过频率和电压依赖性测量得到验证。
AI.motivation: 在He-KPFM中，“直接”异质外差驱动第二本征模的机制已明确，但异质外差驱动运动对第一本征模的动态反作用（特别是在开环操作中）尚未被充分探索。作者旨在揭示这种被忽视的“逆异质外差效应”，并建立其理论框架。
AI.method: 结合双模virial与功率平衡框架，并引入非截断的尖端-表面电容梯度动力学描述，推导出逆异质外差耦合的闭式表达式。通过超高真空开环幅度调制He-KPFM实验进行频率和电压依赖性测量来验证理论预测。

AI.conclusion: 本研究不仅为He-KPFM中模间能量转移提供了定量解释，还将异质外差力显微镜与更广泛的驱动多模系统联系起来，揭示了非线性耦合和频率转换导致的模间能量转移、反作用及耗散可观测量的通用物理机制。

title: Composite-Fermion Study of Cavity-Modified Fractional Quantum Hall Excitation Gaps
summary: We investigate how cavity-mediated attractive electron-electron interactions modify the excitation gaps of fractional quantum Hall states within the composite-fermion framework. We compute both the neutral magnetoroton excitation spectrum and the charged excitation gap relevant to transport experiments for the Laughlin $ν=1/3$ and $ν=1/5$ states. We consider a spin-polarized lowest-Landau-level model in which the interaction is mediated by a cavity mode with a spatially uniform vacuum-field gradient and a finite interaction range controlled by a long-distance cutoff. Finite-size scaling reveals that the transport gap is consistently enhanced by the cavity-induced interaction, with the gap enhancement scaling quadratically with the electron number and with the fourth power of the vacuum-field gradient. By contrast, the magnetoroton spectrum exhibits a richer dependence on the interaction range. The high-$k$ magnetoroton gap is enhanced for all interaction ranges considered, consistent with its close connection to the charged excitation gap, even with the long-range character of the interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文在复合费米子框架下研究了腔场诱导的吸引相互作用如何改变分数量子霍尔态的激发能隙，发现输运能隙随电子数和真空场梯度增强，而磁激子谱对相互作用范围表现出更丰富的依赖性。
AI.motivation: 传统分数量子霍尔态研究主要关注电子间的库仑排斥作用，然而腔量子电动力学中光子-电子耦合可引入有效电子-电子吸引作用。作者系统研究这种腔诱导吸引如何影响Laughlin态的中性磁激子激发谱和带电激发能隙，探索腔调控FQH态的可能。

AI.result: 输运能隙随腔诱导相互作用一致增强，能隙增强与电子数的平方和真空场梯度的四次方成正比。磁激子谱对作用范围更敏感，高k磁激子能隙在所有作用范围内均增强，与输运能隙的增强行为一致。

title: On the capacitance gradient description in Heterodyne Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
comment: 59 pages, 10 figures, 23 references, a supplementary information file is provided
summary:
Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) probes local surface-potential variations through the electrostatic force between a conductive tip and a surface, which depends on the potential difference and the tip-surface capacitance gradient (CG). In heterodyne KPFM, the oscillating tip is usually treated by combining a bias-modulated electric field with a first-order truncated Taylor-series expansion of the CG. Although convenient, this treatment is limited to a poorly defined small-amplitude regime and leaves the convergence of the series unresolved. Here, we establish a rigorous spectral description of the CG dynamics and of the resulting electrostatic force beyond this approximation.
  We formulate a non-truncated Taylor-series description of the CG and prove its convergence for a realistic Hudlet-based capacitance model in both monomodal and bimodal motion. In the monomodal case, we show the equivalence between Fourier-series and Taylor-series descriptions, derive explicit expressions for the dominant Fourier coefficients, and introduce order-truncation criteria that replace the usual qualitative notion of a small-amplitude regime. We then extend the formalism to bimodal motion and derive the effective CG coefficients governing the static, first-eigenmode, and second-eigenmode components of the electrostatic interaction.
  Numerical simulations confirm the convergence of the Taylor-based coefficients toward the Fourier coefficients and support the truncation-regime hierarchy in both configurations. This work establishes the formal basis for describing electrostatic force components and AFM observables in open-loop heterodyne experiments and provides a general framework for CG dynamics in multimode force microscopy involving nonlinear electromechanical coupling and frequency conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）中电容梯度（CG）动力学的严格谱描述，超越传统的一阶截断泰勒展开近似。通过非截断泰勒级数描述CG并证明其在单模态和双模态运动下的收敛性，提出了替代传统"小振幅"定性概念的阶截断准则，并通过数值模拟验证了收敛性。

AI.method: 建立非截断泰勒级数描述CG，基于Hudlet电容模型证明其在单模态和双模态运动中的收敛性；在单模态下证明傅里叶级数与泰勒级数描述的等价性，导出主导傅里叶系数的显式表达式，引入阶截断准则；将形式主义扩展至双模态运动，推导控制静电相互作用的有效CG系数。
AI.result: 数值模拟证实了基于泰勒的系数向傅里叶系数的收敛性，支持两种配置下的截断区域层次结构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开环外差实验中静电力分量和AFM可观测量的描述建立了正式基础，并为涉及非线性机电耦合和频率转换的多模态力显微镜中的CG动力学提供了通用框架。

title: Piezoaxial coupling for strain-selected ferroaxial domain control
summary: We formulate a symmetry-based hierarchy of strain-derived conjugate fields for ferroaxial order, and demonstrate strain-selected ferroaxial domain control using first-principles calculations. Since ferroaxial order is even under both spatial inversion and time reversal, ordinary electric and magnetic fields cannot serve as universal linear conjugate fields. Homogeneous strain, however, can generate symmetry-allowed piezoaxial fields whose leading order is determined by the parent point group and by the chosen ferroaxial-axis component. For basal-plane strain, the leading field is linear in orthorhombic systems, quadratic in tetragonal systems, and cubic in trigonal and hexagonal systems. Cubic parent groups further split into two classes: cubic-I groups, $23$ and $m\bar{3}$, allow linear full-strain fields for selected axes, whereas cubic-II groups, $432$, $\bar{4}3m$, and $m\bar{3}m$, forbid linear fields and require quadratic or cubic strain combinations depending on the selected axis. In trigonal systems, the basal-plane deviatoric strain with signed amplitude $\varepsilon_{\rm u}$ and principal-axis angle $θ$ gives the single-axis field $h\propto\varepsilon_{\rm u}^3\sin6θ$. First-principles calculations for the trigonal ferroaxial compound Na$_2$BaMg(PO$_4$)$_2$ verify both the predicted angular dependence and cubic strain scaling of the ferroaxial domain splitting, and fixed-strain atomic relaxations show strain-selected evolution from the para-axial structure. These results establish static homogeneous strain as a symmetry-allowed conjugate field for ferroaxial order and suggest a route to ferroaxial domain control through strain-field cooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于对称性的应变衍生共轭场层级结构用于铁轴向序参量，并通过第一性原理计算证明应变可选择性地控制铁轴向畴。均匀应变可作为铁轴向序的对称允许共轭场，其主导阶次由母点群和选定的铁轴向轴分量决定。在三角晶系铁轴向化合物Na₂BaMg(PO₄)₂中的计算验证了理论预测，表明静态均匀应变可作为铁轴向序的共轭场，并通过应变场冷却实现畴控制。
AI.motivation: 铁轴向序（ferroaxial order）在空间反演和时间反演下均为偶宇称，因此普通的电场和磁场无法作为其通用的线性共轭场。需要寻找一种能够有效操控铁轴向畴的共轭场。
AI.method: 基于群论对称性分析，建立应变衍生的压电轴向场（piezoaxial fields）层级结构；通过第一性原理计算，在三角晶系铁轴向化合物Na₂BaMg(PO₄)₂中验证应变对铁轴向畴的选择性控制。
AI.result: 不同晶系的应变场主导阶次不同：正交晶系为线性，四方晶系为二次，三角和六方晶系为三次。立方晶系分为两类。在三角晶系中，基面偏应变场h∝εu³sin6θ。第一性原理计算验证了角度依赖性和立方应变标度关系，以及应变选择性的顺电-轴向结构演化。
AI.conclusion: 静态均匀应变是铁轴向序的对称允许共轭场，通过应变场冷却可实现铁轴向畴的控制，为铁轴向材料的畴工程提供了新途径。

title: Radio frequency readout and control of Ge/SiGe hole spin qubits with a global accumulation gate
summary: Hole spin qubits in undoped Ge/SiGe quantum well structures have advanced rapidly in performance and scalability. However, stringent multi-layer patterning and overlay requirements of conventional overlapping-gate devices create a bottleneck for academic proof-of-concept experiments involving few-qubit devices. Here we present fabrication and measurements of Ge/SiGe spin qubit devices with a global accumulation gate and single-layer depletion fine gates, which substantially reduce fabrication complexity. With careful design of the gate-2DHG capacitance, we demonstrate RF-based single-shot spin readout and coherent control of two single-spin qubits. We also characterize the spin coherence times and exchange tunability, which are similar to those reported in recent overlapping-gate Ge/SiGe spin qubit devices. By simplifying fabrication without sacrificing performance, our approach offers a more accessible device design for spin-based quantum technology research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于全局积累栅和单层耗尽精细栅的Ge/SiGe自旋量子比特器件，大幅简化了传统交叠栅极结构的制造复杂度，同时保持了优异的单次自旋读取、相干控制和交换耦合可调性，性能与先进交叠栅器件相当。
AI.motivation: 传统Ge/SiGe自旋量子比特依赖多层交叠栅极结构，其复杂的多层图案化与对准工艺成为学术实验中小型量子器件的瓶颈，亟需更简化的器件设计。
AI.method: 采用全局积累栅结合单层耗尽精细栅的设计，通过优化栅极与二维空穴气(2DHG)间的电容，实现射频单次自旋读取和相干操控。
AI.result: 成功实现两个单自旋量子比特的RF单次读取和相干控制，自旋相干时间和交换耦合可调性与近期交叠栅Ge/SiGe器件相当。
AI.conclusion: 该简化制造工艺在不牺牲性能的前提下，为自旋量子比特研究提供了更易实现的器件方案，有望推动自旋量子技术的可及性发展。

title: Phonon-Mediated Thermal Transport in Nanocrystalline Silicon Using Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Understanding phonon-mediated heat transport in structurally complex materials remains a central challenge for next-generation electronic and nanomechanical devices, where grain boundaries and interfacial disorder strongly limit thermal dissipation. Although classical interatomic potentials enable large-scale simulations, their limited transferability can lead to inaccuracies in vibrational properties and interfacial phonon scattering. In this work, we develop a machine-learning based framework for modeling thermal transport in bulk and nanocrystalline silicon by combining Gaussian approximation potential (GAP) and multi-atomic cluster expansion (MACE) models with lattice-dynamical calculations and non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD). Harmonic and anharmonic force constants derived from machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are used within a unified Phonopy/Phono3py workflow to compute phonon dispersions, lifetimes, and lattice thermal conductivity, providing an internally consistent description of vibrational properties. In nanocrystalline silicon, NEMD simulations directly quantify the thermal boundary resistance associated with grain boundaries and reveal its sensitivity to interfacial roughness and the underlying interatomic description. Compared with the Stillinger-Weber and Tersoff potentials, the MLIPs provide a more accurate and internally consistent description of bulk and interfacial phonon transport, enabling more predictive modeling of nanoscale thermal transport in low-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合GAP和MACE机器学习势与晶格动力学及非平衡分子动力学模拟，构建了一个用于建模体相和纳米晶硅中热输运的框架，相比传统经典势能提供了更准确且内部自洽的描述。
AI.motivation: 理解结构复杂材料中声子介导的热传输对下一代电子和纳米机械器件至关重要，但晶界和界面无序会强烈限制热耗散，而经典势函数的有限迁移性会导致振动性质和界面声子散射的不准确性。
AI.method: 将机器学习势（GAP和MACE）与Phonopy/Phono3py工作流结合，提取谐波和非谐波力常数以计算声子色散、寿命和晶格热导率；利用NEMD模拟直接量化纳米晶硅中的界面热阻。
AI.result: MLIPs相比Stillinger-Weber和Tersoff势提供了更准确且内部自洽的体相和界面声子输运描述，揭示了界面粗糙度对热边界阻的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 该机器学习框架能够更可预测地建模低维材料中的纳米尺度热输运，解决了经典势在复杂界面系统中的局限性。

title: Correlated Insulating States in Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene Enhanced by Interfacial Effect on CrOCl
summary: Interaction between different two dimensional materials can give rise to many exotic physical phenomena which are rarely observed in intrinsic materials. Recently, several theoretical and experimental works have revealed that magnetic proximity effect between pristine graphene and magnetic substrates can lead to the emergence of quantum anomalous Hall states and quantum spin Hall states. However, interplay between correlated states in graphene-based systems and magnetic materials has seldom been studied. Here we perform the transport measurement at ultrahigh magnetic field of twisted double bilayer graphene (TDBG) on CrOCl (COC) substrate, which is an antiferromagnetic material. Instead of a magnetic-exchange effect on graphene, we observe an enhanced correlated insulating state at half-filling factor of TDBG as a result of the charge-transfer process between TDBG and COC. The temperature and magnetic field dependence of this enhanced state are further studied. Our results demonstrate the influence of charge-related effect at the interface, and shed a light on a new route for manipulating the correlated states in graphene-based moiré systems using interfacial engineering.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究了扭曲双层石墨烯（TDBG）与反铁磁材料CrOCl（COC）衬底之间的界面效应。与预期不同，作者未观察到磁交换效应，而是发现了电荷转移过程导致TDBG在半填充因子下的关联绝缘态增强。极磁场下的输运测量揭示了这一增强态的温场依赖特性，展示了通过界面工程调控石墨烯莫尔系统关联态的新途径。
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注石墨烯与磁性衬底间的磁近邻效应（如量子反常霍尔态），但石墨烯基系统中的关联态与磁性材料之间的相互作用鲜有探索。作者旨在探究TDBG与反铁磁COC衬底界面相互作用的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用超强磁场下的输运测量方法，研究TDBG置于反铁磁COC衬底上的电学性质，分析温度与磁场依赖关系。
AI.result: 在TDBG/COC体系中未观察到预期中的磁交换效应，而是发现了由电荷转移过程引起的半填充因子处关联绝缘态的显著增强。

title: Half state at $ν_{tot}$ = -1/2 and its transition in Decoupled Twisted Double Bilayer Graphene
summary: The origin of the fractional state at $ν$ = 1/2 observed in double-layer quantum Hall systems has been under debate for decades. Because of the variation of bilayer charge distribution and interlayer tunneling strength, the half-filling state can be attributed to a two-component(2C) or a one-component(1C) origin, which corresponds to Halperin state and Pffafian state, respectively. Here we report the magnetotransport measurement in decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene(TDBG), which has been proved to be a promising platform for double quantum Hall system. Fractional quantum hall states in both odd and even denominator fillings are observed. We also found that the half-filling state occurs at zero displacement field at $ν_{tot}$ = -1/2, which is theoretically consistent with two-component Halperin-Laughlin (Ψ331) state. Moreover, we report the transition from two-component state at zero D field to one-component non-Abelian state by tunning displacement field. Our observation of the half filling state and its transition from 2C to 1C state provides the tunability of decoupled twisted double bilayer graphene and shed light on the understanding of the ground states at half-filling factor in the double quantum Hall system.

AI.tldr: 本文在解耦的扭曲双双层石墨烯(TDBG)中观测到ν=1/2的分数量子霍尔态，并通过调控位移场实现了从两分量(2C)Halperin态到单分量(1C)非阿贝尔态的转变，解决了双层量子霍尔系统中长期存在的争议。
AI.motivation: 双层量子霍尔系统中ν=1/2分数量子态起源于两分量(2C)Halperin态还是单分量(1C)Pfaffian态，这一争议已持续数十年，需要实验验证。
AI.method: 在解耦的扭曲双双层石墨烯(TDBG)中进行磁输运测量，通过调控位移场来研究半填充态的特性及其转变。
AI.result: 观测到奇偶分母填充的分数量子霍尔态；零位移场下ν_total=-1/2的半填充态与两分量Halperin-Laughlin(Ψ331)态一致；通过调控位移场可观测从两分量态到单分量非阿贝尔态的转变。
AI.conclusion: 解耦的TDBG具有可调谐性，为理解双层量子霍尔系统中半填充因子的基态提供了新见解，实验证实了ν=1/2态的两分量起源及其向单分量态的转变。

title: 2D Transport in an in-plane magnetic field
summary: A parallel in-plane magnetic field could, in principle, distinguish between two competing physical scenarios for the experimentally observed density-tuned 2D metal-insulator transition (where decreasing the carrier density leads to a crossover from an effective metal to an effective insulator): Wigner crystallization or Anderson localization. Since the main scattering mechanism in 2D doped semiconductors arises from screened random charged impurities and screening in turn depends on the electronic density of states, the in-plane magnetic field could distinguish between the two by decreasing screening through spin polarization and this enhances the effective critical density for Anderson localization compared with Wigner crystallization. We give the general theory and provide results for the quantitative magnitudes of the spin polarization effect on the transition density by focusing on two recent experiments [Z. Ge, et al, arXiv:2510.12009, T. Han, et al, arXiv:2604.00113], noting that the critical density may actually decrease if the dominant scattering is by short-ranged defects instead of long-ranged charged impurities. The difference between the two cases arises from whether spin polarization dominates screening (enhanced critical density) or the Fermi surface (suppressed critical density).

AI.tldr: 本文通过面内平行磁场区分二维金属-绝缘体转变的两种竞争机制（维格纳晶化与安德森局域化），提出自旋极化通过改变屏蔽效应影响临界密度，并针对两个最新实验给出定量结果。
AI.motivation: 面内平行磁场理论上可区分密度调控的二维金属-绝缘体转变的两种物理机制：维格纳晶化与安德森局域化。由于两者对自旋极化导致屏蔽效应变化的响应不同，可通过测量临界密度变化来鉴别。
AI.method: 提出一般理论框架，考虑二维掺杂半导体中主要散射机制为屏蔽的随机带电杂质，分析面内磁场通过自旋极化降低屏蔽效应，进而增强安德森局域化有效临界密度（相较于维格纳晶化）。针对两篇最新实验工作给出定量数值结果，并对比短程缺陷散射情形。
AI.result: 自旋极化主导屏蔽时临界密度增强；自旋极化主导费米面时临界密度抑制。两种情况的差异取决于主要散射源是长程带电杂质还是短程缺陷。针对Z. Ge等人和T. Han等人的实验给出了定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 面内平行磁场可作为区分二维金属-绝缘体转变中维格纳晶化与安德森局域化的有效手段，关键在于分析临界密度随自旋极化的变化趋势（增强或抑制）。
